+-
+-/*
+- * Widget Creation Functions
+- * ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
+- */
+-
+-void set_label(struct BGTK_Widget* widget, char* label) {
+-	printf("BGTK: setting label: %s\n", label);
+-	if (widget-&gt;data.label.text) {
+-		free(widget-&gt;data.label.text-&gt;data.text.text);
+-		free(widget-&gt;data.label.text);
+-	}
+-
+-	// Create a new text widget for the label
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* text_widget = bgtk_text(widget-&gt;ctx, label, 0);
+-	if (!text_widget) {
+-		perror(
+-		    "BGTK Failed to create text widget for "
+-		    "label");
+-		return;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;data.label.text = text_widget;
+-
+-	// Calculate size based on text widget
+-	widget-&gt;w = text_widget-&gt;w + 10;  // Add padding
+-	widget-&gt;h = text_widget-&gt;h + 10;  // Add padding
+-
+-	draw_widget(widget-&gt;ctx, widget, widget-&gt;ctx-&gt;shm_buffer);
+-	printf("BGTK label set\n");
+-}
+-
+-struct BGTK_Widget* bgtk_label(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, char* text) {
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* widget = widget_new(ctx, BGTK_WIDGET_LABEL, 0);
+-	printf("BGTK allocated label\n");
+-	if (!widget) {
+-		perror("BGTK Failed to create new widget");
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;set_label = set_label;
+-
+-	// Create a text widget for the label
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* text_widget = bgtk_text(ctx, text, 0);
+-	if (!text_widget) {
+-		perror(
+-		    "BGTK Failed to create text widget for "
+-		    "label");
+-		free(widget);
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;data.label.text = text_widget;
+-
+-	// Calculate size based on text widget
+-	widget-&gt;w = text_widget-&gt;w + 10;  // Add padding
+-	widget-&gt;h = text_widget-&gt;h + 10;  // Add padding
+-
+-	return widget;
+-}
+-
+-struct BGTK_Widget* bgtk_text(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, char* text, int flags) {
+-	printf("BGTK creating text widget\n");
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* widget = widget_new(ctx, BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT, flags);
+-	printf("BGTK allocated text widget\n");
+-	if (!widget) {
+-		perror("BGTK Failed to create new widget");
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	char* ptr = calloc(1, strlen(text) + 1);
+-	sprintf(ptr, "%s", text);
+-	widget-&gt;data.text.text = ptr;
+-
+-	// Calculate size based on text
+-	measure_text(widget-&gt;ctx-&gt;ft_face, widget-&gt;data.text.text, &amp;widget-&gt;w,
+-		     &amp;widget-&gt;h);
+-
+-	return widget;
+-}
+-
+-struct BGTK_Widget* bgtk_button(struct BGTK_Context* ctx,
+-				struct BGTK_Widget* label,
+-				BGTK_Callback callback, int flags) {
+-	printf("BGTK creating button widget\n");
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* widget = widget_new(ctx, BGTK_WIDGET_BUTTON, flags);
+-	if (!widget) {
+-		perror("BGTK Failed to create new widget");
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;data.button.callback = callback;
+-	widget-&gt;data.button.label = label;
+-
+-	// Calculate size based on label widget
+-	widget-&gt;w = label-&gt;w + 20;  // Add padding
+-	widget-&gt;h = label-&gt;h + 20;  // Add padding
+-	return widget;
+-}
+-
+-// --- Layout/Management Functions ---
+-
+-// Helper to recalculate the content height of a scrollable
+-// widget
+-struct BGTK_Widget* bgtk_scrollable(struct BGTK_Context* ctx,
+-				    struct BGTK_Widget** widgets,
+-				    int widget_count, int flags) {
+-	printf("BGTK creating scrollable widget\n");
+-	struct BGTK_Widget* widget =
+-	    widget_new(ctx, BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE, flags);
+-	if (!widget) {
+-		perror("BGTK Failed to create scrollable widget");
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widgets = (struct BGTK_Widget**)calloc(
+-	    widget_count, sizeof(struct BGTK_Widget*));
+-	if (!widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widgets) {
+-		perror("calloc");
+-		free(widget);
+-		return NULL;
+-	}
+-
+-	// Copy the input widgets into the scrollable container
+-	widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = widget_count;
+-	widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
+-	widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height = 0;
+-	for (int i = 0; i &lt; widget_count; i++) {
+-		widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widgets[i] = widgets[i];
+-		widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height +=
+-		    widgets[i]-&gt;h + 5;	// 5px spacing
+-	}
+-
+-	// Initialize tmp buffer to NULL, it will be allocated
+-	// during drawing
+-	widget-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp = NULL;
+-	printf("BGTK allocated scrollable widget\n");
+-
+-	return widget;
+-}
+diff --git a/drawing.c b/drawing.c
+new file mode 100644
+index 0000000..daf0688
+--- /dev/null
++++ b/drawing.c
+@@ -0,0 +1,308 @@
++#include "bgtk.h"
++#include "internal.h"
++#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
++
++// A few basic colors (0xAARRGGBB)
++#define BGTK_COLOR_BG 0xFFCCCCCC     // Light Gray
++#define BGTK_COLOR_BTN 0xFF007BFF    // Blue
++#define BGTK_COLOR_TEXT 0xFF000000   // Black
++#define BGTK_COLOR_WHITE 0xFFFFFFFF  // White
++
++void clear_buffer(struct BGTK_Context* ctx) {
++	uint32_t* pixels = (uint32_t*)ctx-&gt;shm_buffer;
++	size_t size = (size_t)ctx-&gt;width * ctx-&gt;height;
++	for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; size; i++) {
++		pixels[i] = BGTK_COLOR_BG;
++	}
++}
++
++void draw_rect(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, uint32_t* pixels, int x, int y,
++		      int w, int h, uint32_t color) {
++	// Basic clipping and drawing
++	int x1 = x;
++	int y1 = y;
++	int x2 = x + w;
++	int y2 = y + h;
++
++	// Clip to buffer bounds
++	if (x1 &lt; 0) {
++		x1 = 0;
++	}
++	if (y1 &lt; 0) {
++		y1 = 0;
++	}
++	if (x2 &gt; (int)ctx-&gt;width) {
++		x2 = ctx-&gt;width;
++	}
++	if (y2 &gt; (int)ctx-&gt;height) {
++		y2 = ctx-&gt;height;
++	}
++
++	int stride = ctx-&gt;width;
++
++	for (int j = y1; j &lt; y2; j++) {
++		for (int i = x1; i &lt; x2; i++) {
++			pixels[j * stride + i] = color;
++		}
++	}
++}
++
++void measure_text(FT_Face face, const char* text, int* out_width,
++		  int* out_height) {
++	int width = 0;
++
++	for (const char* p = text; *p; p++) {
++		if (FT_Load_Char(face, *p, FT_LOAD_DEFAULT)) {
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		width += face-&gt;glyph-&gt;advance.x;  // 26.6 units
++	}
++
++	width &gt;&gt;= 6;
++
++	int ascent = face-&gt;size-&gt;metrics.ascender &gt;&gt; 6;
++	int descent = -face-&gt;size-&gt;metrics.descender &gt;&gt; 6;
++	int height = ascent + descent;
++
++	*out_width = width;
++	*out_height = height;
++}
++
++void calculate_widget_size(struct BGTK_Context* ctx,
++				  struct BGTK_Widget* w) {
++	if (!w) {
++		return;
++	}
++
++	switch (w-&gt;type) {
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_LABEL:
++			if (w-&gt;data.label.text) {
++				calculate_widget_size(ctx, w-&gt;data.label.text);
++				w-&gt;w =
++				    w-&gt;data.label.text-&gt;w + 10;	 // Add padding
++				w-&gt;h =
++				    w-&gt;data.label.text-&gt;h + 10;	 // Add padding
++			}
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT:
++			if (w-&gt;data.text.text) {
++				measure_text(ctx-&gt;ft_face, w-&gt;data.text.text,
++					     &amp;w-&gt;w, &amp;w-&gt;h);
++			}
++			printf("calcutated text size: %ux%u\n", w-&gt;w, w-&gt;h);
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_BUTTON:
++			if (w-&gt;data.button.label) {
++				calculate_widget_size(ctx,
++						      w-&gt;data.button.label);
++				w-&gt;w = w-&gt;data.button.label-&gt;w +
++				       20;  // Add padding
++				w-&gt;h = w-&gt;data.button.label-&gt;h +
++				       20;  // Add padding
++			}
++			printf("calcutated button size: %ux%u\n", w-&gt;w, w-&gt;h);
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE:
++			w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height = 0;
++			for (int i = 0; i &lt; w-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count;
++			     i++) {
++				struct BGTK_Widget* child =
++				    w-&gt;data.scrollable.widgets[i];
++				calculate_widget_size(ctx, child);
++				w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height +=
++				    child-&gt;h + 5;  // 5px spacing
++			}
++			printf("calcutated scrollable size: %ux%u\n", w-&gt;w,
++			       w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height);
++			break;
++		default:
++			break;
++	}
++}
++
++void draw_text(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, uint32_t* pixels,
++		      const char* text, int x, int y, uint32_t color) {
++	if (!ctx-&gt;ft_face) {
++		// Fallback to simple placeholder if font didn't load
++		draw_rect(ctx, pixels, x, y, 5, 5, color);
++		return;
++	}
++
++	// Set font size for drawing context
++	FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(ctx-&gt;ft_face, 0, ctx-&gt;font_size);
++
++	int pen_x = x;
++	int pen_y = y + (ctx-&gt;ft_face-&gt;size-&gt;metrics.ascender &gt;&gt; 6);
++
++	int stride = ctx-&gt;width;
++
++	for (const char* p = text; *p; p++) {
++		FT_UInt index = FT_Get_Char_Index(ctx-&gt;ft_face, *p);
++
++		if (FT_Load_Glyph(ctx-&gt;ft_face, index,
++				  FT_LOAD_DEFAULT | FT_LOAD_TARGET_LIGHT)) {
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		FT_Render_Glyph(ctx-&gt;ft_face-&gt;glyph, FT_RENDER_MODE_NORMAL);
++
++		FT_GlyphSlot slot = ctx-&gt;ft_face-&gt;glyph;
++		FT_Bitmap* bitmap = &amp;slot-&gt;bitmap;
++
++		int gx = pen_x + slot-&gt;bitmap_left;
++		int gy = pen_y - slot-&gt;bitmap_top;
++
++		for (unsigned int row = 0; row &lt; bitmap-&gt;rows; row++) {
++			for (unsigned int col = 0; col &lt; bitmap-&gt;width; col++) {
++				uint8_t a =
++				    bitmap-&gt;buffer[row * bitmap-&gt;pitch + col];
++				if (a == 0) {
++					continue;
++				}
++
++				int32_t dx = gx + col;
++				int32_t dy = gy + row;
++				if (dx &lt; 0 || dx &gt;= (int)ctx-&gt;width || dy &lt; 0 ||
++				    dy &gt;= (int)ctx-&gt;height) {
++					continue;
++				}
++
++				// Blend
++				uint32_t dst = pixels[dy * stride + dx];
++				uint8_t inv = 255 - a;
++
++				uint8_t r_dst = (dst &gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xFF;
++				uint8_t g_dst = (dst &gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xFF;
++				uint8_t b_dst = (dst) &amp; 0xFF;
++
++				uint8_t r_src = (color &gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xFF;
++				uint8_t g_src = (color &gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xFF;
++				uint8_t b_src = (color) &amp; 0xFF;
++
++				uint8_t r = (r_src * a + r_dst * inv) / 255;
++				uint8_t g = (g_src * a + g_dst * inv) / 255;
++				uint8_t b = (b_src * a + b_dst * inv) / 255;
++
++				pixels[dy * stride + dx] =
++				    (r &lt;&lt; 16) | (g &lt;&lt; 8) | b;
++			}
++		}
++
++		pen_x += slot-&gt;advance.x &gt;&gt; 6;
++	}
++}
++
++void draw_widget(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, struct BGTK_Widget* w,
++			uint32_t* pixels) {
++	switch (w-&gt;type) {
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_LABEL:
++
++			// Draw label background
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y, w-&gt;w, w-&gt;h,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_BG);
++			// Draw text widget (offset for padding)
++			if (w-&gt;data.label.text) {
++				w-&gt;data.label.text-&gt;x = w-&gt;x + 5;
++				w-&gt;data.label.text-&gt;y = w-&gt;y + 5;
++				draw_widget(ctx, w-&gt;data.label.text, pixels);
++			}
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT:
++			puts("drawing text widget");
++			draw_text(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;data.text.text, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_TEXT);
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_BUTTON:
++			puts("drawing button widget");
++			// Draw button background
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y, w-&gt;w, w-&gt;h,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_BTN);
++
++			// Draw button border (1px black)
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y, w-&gt;w, 1,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_TEXT);  // Top
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y + w-&gt;h - 1, w-&gt;w, 1,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_TEXT);  // Bottom
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x, w-&gt;y, 1, w-&gt;h,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_TEXT);  // Left
++			draw_rect(ctx, pixels, w-&gt;x + w-&gt;w - 1, w-&gt;y, 1, w-&gt;h,
++				  BGTK_COLOR_TEXT);  // Right
++
++			// Draw label widget (offset for padding)
++			if (w-&gt;data.button.label) {
++				w-&gt;data.button.label-&gt;x = w-&gt;x + 10;
++				w-&gt;data.button.label-&gt;y = w-&gt;y + 10;
++				draw_widget(ctx, w-&gt;data.button.label, pixels);
++			}
++			break;
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE:
++			puts("drawing scrollable widget");
++			// Allocate or update the off-screen buffer if
++			// needed
++			if (!w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp) {
++				int content_height =
++				    w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height;
++				if (w-&gt;h &gt; content_height) {
++					content_height = w-&gt;h;
++				}
++
++				// Allocate the off-screen buffer
++				w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp = calloc(
++				    w-&gt;w * content_height, sizeof(uint32_t));
++				if (!w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp) {
++					fprintf(stderr,
++						"Failed to allocate "
++						"off-screen "
++						"buffer\n");
++					break;
++				}
++				draw_rect(ctx, w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp, 0, 0,
++					  w-&gt;w,
++					  w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height,
++					  BGTK_COLOR_BG);
++
++				// Draw child widgets into the
++				// off-screen buffer
++				int current_y = 0;
++				for (int i = 0;
++				     i &lt; w-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++					struct BGTK_Widget* child =
++					    w-&gt;data.scrollable.widgets[i];
++
++					child-&gt;x = w-&gt;x + 5;  // 5px padding
++					if (w-&gt;flags &amp; BGTK_FLAG_CENTER) {
++						child-&gt;x =
++						    w-&gt;x +
++						    (w-&gt;w - child-&gt;w) / 2;
++					}
++					child-&gt;y = current_y;
++					draw_widget(ctx, child,
++						    w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp);
++					current_y +=
++					    child-&gt;h + 5;  // 5px spacing
++				}
++			}
++
++			// Copy the off-screen buffer to the framebuffer
++			// according to scroll position
++			uint32_t* buff = ctx-&gt;shm_buffer;
++			uint32_t* tmp = w-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp;
++			for (int row = 0; row &lt; w-&gt;h; row++) {
++				if (w-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y + row &lt;
++				    w-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height) {
++					memcpy(
++					    &amp;buff[(w-&gt;y + row) * ctx-&gt;width +
++						  w-&gt;x],
++					    &amp;tmp[(w-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y +
++						  row) *
++						 w-&gt;w],
++					    w-&gt;w * 4);
++				}
++			}
++
++			break;
++	}
++}
++

+ // Text input event handler
+-static int text_input_handle_event(struct BGTK_Widget* widget, struct InputEvent ev) {
+-    // First check if the event is within the text input's bounds
+-    if (!(ev.x &gt;= widget-&gt;x &amp;&amp; ev.x &lt; (widget-&gt;x + widget-&gt;w) &amp;&amp;
+-          ev.y &gt;= widget-&gt;y &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; (widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h))) {

+-                widget-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos++;

+-                if (widget-&gt;data.text_input.on_change) {

+-                }

+-                widget-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos--;

+-                if (widget-&gt;data.text_input.on_change) {

+-                }
+-                
+-                return 1; // Event handled

+-        }

+-                widget-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos--;
+-                return 1; // Event handled

+-                widget-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos++;
+-                return 1; // Event handled
+-            }
+-        }
+-    }
+-    
+-    return 0; // Event not handled by this specific handler

+ // Scrollable event handler
+-static int scrollable_handle_event(struct BGTK_Widget* widget, struct InputEvent ev) {
+-    // First check if the event is within the scrollable's bounds
+-    if (!(ev.x &gt;= widget-&gt;x &amp;&amp; ev.x &lt; (widget-&gt;x + widget-&gt;w) &amp;&amp;
+-          ev.y &gt;= widget-&gt;y &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; (widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h))) {
+-        return 0; // Event not in this widget
+-    }
+-    
+-    // Handle mouse wheel for scrolling
+-    if (ev.code == REL_WHEEL) {
+-        widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y -= ev.value * 10;  // Scroll speed
+-        
+-        // Clamp scroll_y to valid range
+-        if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &lt; 0) {
+-            widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
+-        }
+-        if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &gt;
+-            widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height - widget-&gt;h) {
+-            widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y =
+-                widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height - widget-&gt;h;
+-        }
+-        if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &lt; 0) {
+-            widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
+-        }
+-        
+-        return 1; // Event handled
+-    }
+-    
+-    // Pass event to child widgets
+-    for (int i = 0; i &lt; widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
+-        struct BGTK_Widget* child = widget-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
+-        
+-        // Adjust event coordinates to be relative to the child widget
+-        struct InputEvent child_ev = ev;
+-        child_ev.x -= child-&gt;x;
+-        child_ev.y -= child-&gt;y;
+-        
+-        // Pass the event to the child
+-        if (child-&gt;handle_event(child, child_ev)) {
+-            return 1; // Event was handled by a child
+-        }
+-    }
+-    
+-    return 0; // Event not handled
++static int scrollable_handle_event(struct BGTK_Widget* widget,
++				   struct InputEvent ev) {
++	printf(
++	    "[BGTK][event] widget=SCROLLABLE type=%d pos=%d,%d "
++	    "size=%dx%d "
++	    "scroll_y=%d content_h=%d ev{type=%d code=%d value=%d x=%d "
++	    "y=%d}\n",
++	    widget-&gt;type, widget-&gt;x, widget-&gt;y, widget-&gt;w, widget-&gt;h,
++	    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y,
++	    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height, ev.type, ev.code, ev.value,
++	    ev.x, ev.y);
++
++	// First check if the event is within the scrollable's bounds
++	if (!(ev.x &gt;= widget-&gt;x &amp;&amp; ev.x &lt; (widget-&gt;x + widget-&gt;w) &amp;&amp;
++	      ev.y &gt;= widget-&gt;y &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; (widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h))) {
++		return 0;  // Event not in this widget
++	}
++
++	// Keyboard events don't have meaningful pointer coordinates.
++	if (ev.type == EV_KEY &amp;&amp; ev.code &lt; BTN_MISC) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget* child =
++			    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
++			if (child-&gt;handle_event(child, ev)) {
++				return 1;  // Event was handled by a child
++			}
++		}
++	}
++
++	// Pass event to child widgets first (if the pointer coordinates match)
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; widget-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++		struct BGTK_Widget* child = widget-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
++		// Children are positioned relative to the scrollable content
++		// origin. Hit-test in absolute coordinates, accounting for
++		// scroll_y.
++		int child_abs_x0 = widget-&gt;x + child-&gt;x;
++		int child_abs_y0 =
++		    widget-&gt;y + child-&gt;y - widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y;
++		int child_abs_x1 = child_abs_x0 + child-&gt;w;
++		int child_abs_y1 = child_abs_y0 + child-&gt;h;
++
++		// Only consider children that are at least partially on-screen
++		// within the scrollable's visible rect.
++		int vis_x0 = widget-&gt;x;
++		int vis_y0 = widget-&gt;y;
++		int vis_x1 = widget-&gt;x + widget-&gt;w;
++		int vis_y1 = widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h;
++
++		if (child_abs_x1 &lt;= vis_x0 || child_abs_x0 &gt;= vis_x1 ||
++		    child_abs_y1 &lt;= vis_y0 || child_abs_y0 &gt;= vis_y1) {
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		if (!(ev.x &gt;= child_abs_x0 &amp;&amp; ev.x &lt; child_abs_x1 &amp;&amp;
++		      ev.y &gt;= child_abs_y0 &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; child_abs_y1)) {
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		if (child-&gt;handle_event(child, ev)) {
++			return 1;  // Event was handled by a child
++		}
++
++		// Coordinates matched this child, but it didn't handle
++		// the event. The scrollable should now try to handle it.
++		break;
++	}
++
++	// Handle mouse wheel for scrolling
++	// (wheel events come in as EV_REL / REL_WHEEL)
++	if (ev.type == EV_REL &amp;&amp; ev.code == REL_WHEEL) {
++		int old_scroll_y = widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y;
++
++		widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y -=
++		    ev.value * 10;  // Scroll speed
++
++		// Clamp scroll_y to valid range
++		if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &lt; 0) {
++			widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
++		}
++		if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &gt;
++		    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height - widget-&gt;h) {
++			widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y =
++			    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.content_height - widget-&gt;h;
++		}
++		if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y &lt; 0) {
++			widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
++		}
++
++		if (widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y == old_scroll_y) {
++			return 0;  // Nothing changed; avoid needless
++				   // redraw/blink
++		}
++
++		printf(
++		    "[BGTK][event] widget=SCROLLABLE scrolled "
++		    "scroll_y=%d\n",
++		    widget-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y);
++		if (widget-&gt;ctx) {
++			bgtk_draw_widgets(widget-&gt;ctx);
++		}
++		return 1;  // Event handled
++	}
++	
++	if (ev.code == BTN_LEFT &amp;&amp; ev.value == 1) {
++		bgtk_set_focus(widget-&gt;ctx, widget);
++		return 1;
++	}
++
++	return 0;  // Event not handled
+ }
+

+-          ev.y &gt;= widget-&gt;y &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; (widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h))) {

+
+    build: include FreeType (and libxml) under $HOME/.local.
+
+    Add include/freetype2 and include/libxml2, always -L$HOME/.local/lib for
+    freetype, and search home pkgconfig so home-prefix FreeType is found.
+
+<a href=tree-a566406.html>tree</a>

+diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile

+ # the common Linux location.
+ CC ?= cc
+ 
+-FREETYPE_CFLAGS := $(shell pkg-config --cflags freetype2 2&gt;/dev/null)
++# User-local prefix (bgce, freetype, libxml, etc. under a home install).
++HOME_LOCAL ?= $(HOME)/.local
++# FreeType headers live in include/freetype2, not only include/.
++HOME_LOCAL_CFLAGS = -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include/freetype2 \
++	-I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include/libxml2
++HOME_LOCAL_LDFLAGS = -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib
++# So pkg-config finds .pc files from a home-prefix install.
++PKG_CONFIG_ENV = PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib/pkgconfig:$(HOME_LOCAL)/share/pkgconfig:$${PKG_CONFIG_PATH}"
++
++FREETYPE_CFLAGS := $(shell $(PKG_CONFIG_ENV) pkg-config --cflags freetype2 2&gt;/dev/null)
+ ifeq ($(FREETYPE_CFLAGS),)
+-  FREETYPE_CFLAGS := -I/include/freetype2
++  FREETYPE_CFLAGS := -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include/freetype2 -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include \
++	-I/include/freetype2
+ endif
+ 
+-FREETYPE_LIBS := $(shell pkg-config --libs freetype2 2&gt;/dev/null)
+-FREETYPE_LIBDIRS :=
++FREETYPE_LIBS := $(shell $(PKG_CONFIG_ENV) pkg-config --libs freetype2 2&gt;/dev/null)
++# Always search home lib for -lfreetype even when pkg-config returns flags.
++FREETYPE_LIBDIRS := -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib
+ ifeq ($(FREETYPE_LIBS),)
+   # Flat /lib (lin0) plus macOS Homebrew fallbacks for dev hosts
+   FREETYPE_LIBS := -lfreetype
+-  FREETYPE_LIBDIRS := -L/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/freetype/lib -L/usr/local/opt/freetype/lib -L/opt/homebrew/lib -L/usr/local/lib
++  FREETYPE_LIBDIRS += -L/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/freetype/lib -L/usr/local/opt/freetype/lib -L/opt/homebrew/lib -L/usr/local/lib
+ endif
+ 
+-OPENSSL_CFLAGS := $(shell pkg-config --cflags openssl 2&gt;/dev/null)
++OPENSSL_CFLAGS := $(shell $(PKG_CONFIG_ENV) pkg-config --cflags openssl 2&gt;/dev/null)
+ ifeq ($(OPENSSL_CFLAGS),)
+-  OPENSSL_CFLAGS := -I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include -I/opt/homebrew/include -I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include
++  OPENSSL_CFLAGS := -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include \
++	-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include \
++	-I/opt/homebrew/include -I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include
+ endif
+-OPENSSL_LIBDIRS := -L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib -L/opt/homebrew/lib -L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib -L/usr/local/lib
++OPENSSL_LIBDIRS := -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib \
++	-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib \
++	-L/opt/homebrew/lib -L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib -L/usr/local/lib
+ OPENSSL_LIBS := -lssl -lcrypto
+ 
+-LIBXML2_CFLAGS := $(shell pkg-config --cflags libxml-2.0 2&gt;/dev/null)
++LIBXML2_CFLAGS := $(shell $(PKG_CONFIG_ENV) pkg-config --cflags libxml-2.0 2&gt;/dev/null)
+ ifeq ($(LIBXML2_CFLAGS),)
+-  LIBXML2_CFLAGS := -I/include/libxml2
++  LIBXML2_CFLAGS := -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include/libxml2 -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include \
++	-I/include/libxml2
+ endif
+-LIBXML2_LIBS := $(shell pkg-config --libs libxml-2.0 2&gt;/dev/null)
++LIBXML2_LIBS := $(shell $(PKG_CONFIG_ENV) pkg-config --libs libxml-2.0 2&gt;/dev/null)
+ ifeq ($(LIBXML2_LIBS),)
+-  LIBXML2_LIBS := -lxml2
++  LIBXML2_LIBS := -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib -lxml2
+ endif
+ 
+ COMPAT_DIR := compat
+ UNAME_S := $(shell uname)
+ 
+-# User-local prefix (bgce, freetype, etc. under a home install).
+-HOME_LOCAL ?= $(HOME)/.local
+-HOME_LOCAL_CFLAGS = -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include
+-HOME_LOCAL_LDFLAGS = -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib

+ # Base compile flags. Do NOT put -fPIC here: TinyCC errors with

+ 	@echo "  CC=$(CC)"

+-	@echo "  HOME_LOCAL=$(HOME_LOCAL)   # added as -I.../include and -L.../lib"
++	@echo "  HOME_LOCAL=$(HOME_LOCAL)"
++	@echo "    compile: -I\$$HOME_LOCAL/include{,/freetype2,/libxml2}"
++	@echo "    link:    -L\$$HOME_LOCAL/lib  (and pkg-config under lib/pkgconfig)"
+ 	@echo "  PREFIX=$(if $(PREFIX),$(PREFIX),(empty → flat /lib /include /bin))"
+ 	@echo "  INSTALL_LIB=$(INSTALL_LIB)"

++/*
++ * Labyrinth — BGTK web browser (HTML shell).
++ *
++ * Layout mirrors gemini_browser: content area on top, URL bar at the bottom.
++ * Documents are rendered with bgtk_html_parse_inline() (libxml2 → widgets).
++ *
++ * Document pipeline (current vs planned):
++ *
++ *   [fetch]  about: | file: | http: | https: (libtls)
++ *      ↓
++ *   [decode] charset (placeholder: assume UTF-8)
++ *      ↓
++ *   [css]    collect &lt;style&gt;/link stylesheets → cascade (placeholder)
++ *      ↓
++ *   [html]   bgtk_html_parse_inline → widget tree   ← implemented
++ *      ↓
++ *   [style]  apply computed styles to widgets       (placeholder)
++ *      ↓
++ *   [js]     run scripts / bind events              (placeholder)
++ *      ↓
++ *   [wire]   &lt;a href&gt; → navigate()                  (placeholder)
++ *
++ * Keys (gemini-like): Ctrl+L focus URL · Ctrl+R reload · b back ·
++ *   H home · j/k/Page* scroll · Esc blur URL then quit · q quit.
++ *
++ * Build: make labyrinth
++ * Test:  make test_labyrinth &amp;&amp; ./test_labyrinth
++ */

++/* Scan HTML for future pipeline stages (no side effects yet). */
++static void labyrinth_scan_pipeline(const char *html)
++{
++	const char *p;
++
++	last_style_blocks = last_script_blocks = last_anchor_count = 0;
++	if (!html)
++		return;
++	for (p = html; *p; p++) {
++		if (!strncmp(p, "&lt;style", 6) || !strncmp(p, "&lt;STYLE", 6))
++			last_style_blocks++;
++		else if (!strncmp(p, "&lt;script", 7) || !strncmp(p, "&lt;SCRIPT", 7))
++			last_script_blocks++;
++		else if (!strncmp(p, "&lt;a ", 3) || !strncmp(p, "&lt;A ", 3) ||
++			 !strncmp(p, "&lt;a&gt;", 3) || !strncmp(p, "&lt;A&gt;", 3))
++			last_anchor_count++;
++	}
++	bgtk_log("labyrinth pipeline scan: style=%d script=%d a=%d",
++		 last_style_blocks, last_script_blocks, last_anchor_count);
++}

++static void labyrinth_chrome(int *pad, int *fmar, int *bw)
++{
++	int p = (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.padding &gt; 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.padding : 12;
++	int m = (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.frame_margin &gt;= 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.frame_margin
++						      : 0;
++	int b = ctx ? (int)ctx-&gt;theme.frame_border_size : 1;
++
++	if (b &lt; 1)
++		b = 1;
++	if (pad)
++		*pad = p;
++	if (fmar)
++		*fmar = m;
++	if (bw)
++		*bw = b;
++}
++
++static int list_v_overhead(int n, int list_m, int list_p)
++{
++	if (n &lt; 1)
++		return 2 * (list_m + list_p);
++	return 2 * list_m * (n - 1) + 2 * (list_m + list_p);
++}
++
++static void labyrinth_layout_chrome(void)
++{
++	int pad, fmar, bw, box_w, box_h, field_pad;
++	int usable_w, ah, host_h, over;
++
++	if (!ctx || !content_host || !addr_input)
++		return;
++
++	labyrinth_chrome(&amp;pad, &amp;fmar, &amp;bw);
++	box_w = ctx-&gt;width - 2 * (fmar + bw + pad);
++	box_h = ctx-&gt;height - 2 * (fmar + bw + pad);
++	if (box_w &lt; 80)
++		box_w = 80;
++	if (box_h &lt; 80)
++		box_h = 80;
++
++	field_pad = pad &gt; 4 ? pad / 2 : 4;
++	addr_input-&gt;padding = field_pad;
++	addr_input-&gt;margin = 0;
++	content_host-&gt;padding = 0;
++	content_host-&gt;margin = 0;
++
++	if (main_list) {
++		main_list-&gt;padding = 0;
++		main_list-&gt;margin = 0;
++		main_list-&gt;w = box_w;
++		main_list-&gt;h = box_h;
++	}
++	if (root_frame) {
++		root_frame-&gt;padding = pad;
++		root_frame-&gt;margin = fmar;
++		root_frame-&gt;w = ctx-&gt;width;
++		root_frame-&gt;h = ctx-&gt;height;
++	}
++
++	usable_w = box_w;
++	{
++		int text_h = ctx-&gt;font_size &gt; 0 ? ctx-&gt;font_size + 4 : 18;
++
++		addr_input-&gt;h =
++			text_h + 2 * (addr_input-&gt;padding + addr_input-&gt;margin);
++		if (addr_input-&gt;h &lt; 28)
++			addr_input-&gt;h = 28;
++	}
++	ah = addr_input-&gt;h;
++	over = list_v_overhead(2, 0, 0);
++	host_h = box_h - ah - over;
++	if (host_h &lt; 40)
++		host_h = 40;
++
++	content_host-&gt;w = usable_w;
++	content_host-&gt;h = host_h;
++	addr_input-&gt;w = usable_w;
++	content_w = usable_w;
++	content_h = host_h;
++
++	/* Resize live page frame if present. */
++	if (content_host-&gt;data.frame.child) {
++		struct BGTK_Widget *page = content_host-&gt;data.frame.child;
++
++		page-&gt;w = content_w;
++		page-&gt;h = content_h;
++		if (page-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_FRAME &amp;&amp; page-&gt;data.frame.child) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *sc = page-&gt;data.frame.child;
++
++			sc-&gt;w = content_w;
++			sc-&gt;h = content_h;
++			if (sc-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE &amp;&amp;
++			    sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp) {
++				free(sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp);
++				sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp = NULL;
++				sc-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_capacity = 0;
++				sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp_items = NULL;
++				sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp_item0 = NULL;
++				sc-&gt;data.scrollable.tmp_nitems = 0;
++			}
++		}
++	}
++}

++		return;

++		memmove(hist[0], hist[1], (HIST_MAX - 1) * sizeof(hist[0]));
++		hist_n = HIST_MAX - 1;
++	}
++	snprintf(hist[hist_n], sizeof(hist[0]), "%s", url);

++}

++static char *read_file_all(const char *path, size_t *out_len)
++{
++	FILE *f;
++	char *buf;
++	long sz;
++
++	f = fopen(path, "rb");
++	if (!f)
++		return NULL;
++	if (fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) {
++		fclose(f);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	sz = ftell(f);
++	if (sz &lt; 0 || sz &gt; 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
++		fclose(f);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	rewind(f);
++	buf = malloc((size_t)sz + 1);
++	if (!buf) {
++		fclose(f);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (fread(buf, 1, (size_t)sz, f) != (size_t)sz) {
++		free(buf);
++		fclose(f);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	fclose(f);
++	buf[sz] = '\0';
++	if (out_len)
++		*out_len = (size_t)sz;
++	return buf;
++}
++
++/* Parse http(s)://host[:port]/path into host/path/port. Returns 0 on success. */
++static int parse_http_url(const char *url, int is_https, char *host, size_t hostlen,
++			  char *path, size_t pathlen, int *port_out)
++{
++	const char *p, *slash;
++	int port = is_https ? 443 : 80;
++
++	if (!url || !host || !path || hostlen &lt; 2 || pathlen &lt; 2)
++		return -1;
++	if (is_https) {
++		if (strncmp(url, "https://", 8) != 0)
++			return -1;
++		p = url + 8;
++	} else {
++		if (strncmp(url, "http://", 7) != 0)
++			return -1;
++		p = url + 7;
++	}
++	slash = strchr(p, '/');
++	if (slash) {
++		size_t hl = (size_t)(slash - p);
++
++		if (hl &gt;= hostlen)
++			hl = hostlen - 1;
++		memcpy(host, p, hl);
++		host[hl] = '\0';
++		snprintf(path, pathlen, "%s", slash);
++	} else {
++		snprintf(host, hostlen, "%s", p);
++		snprintf(path, pathlen, "/");
++	}
++	{
++		char *col = strchr(host, ':');
++
++		if (col) {
++			*col = '\0';
++			port = atoi(col + 1);
++			if (port &lt; 1)
++				port = is_https ? 443 : 80;
++		}
++	}
++	if (!host[0])
++		return -1;
++	if (port_out)
++		*port_out = port;
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static char *http_strip_headers(char *raw, size_t len, int *out_status)
++{
++	char *hdr_end, *payload, *out;
++	size_t blen;
++	int status = 0;
++
++	if (!raw || len &lt; 12) {
++		free(raw);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (sscanf(raw, "HTTP/%*s %d", &amp;status) == 1 &amp;&amp; out_status)
++		*out_status = status;
++	hdr_end = strstr(raw, "\r\n\r\n");
++	if (!hdr_end) {
++		if (out_status &amp;&amp; !*out_status)
++			*out_status = status;
++		return raw;
++	}
++	payload = hdr_end + 4;
++	blen = len - (size_t)(payload - raw);
++	out = malloc(blen + 1);
++	if (!out) {
++		free(raw);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	memcpy(out, payload, blen);
++	out[blen] = '\0';
++	free(raw);
++	return out;
++}
++
++/* Minimal HTTP/1.0 GET over plain TCP. */
++static char *http_get(const char *url, int *out_status, char *err, size_t errlen)
++{
++	char host[256], path[512], portstr[16];
++	int port = 80, fd = -1;
++	struct addrinfo hints, *res = NULL, *rp;
++	char req[1024], *body = NULL;
++	size_t cap = 0, len = 0;
++	ssize_t n;
++	char chunk[4096];
++
++	if (err &amp;&amp; errlen)
++		err[0] = '\0';
++	if (out_status)
++		*out_status = 0;
++	if (parse_http_url(url, 0, host, sizeof(host), path, sizeof(path),
++			   &amp;port) != 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "bad http URL");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	snprintf(portstr, sizeof(portstr), "%d", port);
++	memset(&amp;hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
++	hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
++	hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
++	if (getaddrinfo(host, portstr, &amp;hints, &amp;res) != 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "DNS failed for %s", host);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	for (rp = res; rp; rp = rp-&gt;ai_next) {
++		fd = socket(rp-&gt;ai_family, rp-&gt;ai_socktype, rp-&gt;ai_protocol);
++		if (fd &lt; 0)
++			continue;
++		if (connect(fd, rp-&gt;ai_addr, rp-&gt;ai_addrlen) == 0)
++			break;
++		close(fd);
++		fd = -1;
++	}
++	freeaddrinfo(res);
++	if (fd &lt; 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "connect failed");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++
++	snprintf(req, sizeof(req),
++		 "GET %s HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: %s\r\nUser-Agent: Labyrinth/0.1 "
++		 "(BGTK)\r\nAccept: text/html,*/*\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
++		 path, host);
++	if (write(fd, req, strlen(req)) &lt; 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "write failed");
++		close(fd);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++
++	while ((n = read(fd, chunk, sizeof(chunk))) &gt; 0) {
++		if (len + (size_t)n + 1 &gt; cap) {
++			size_t ncap = cap ? cap * 2 : 8192;
++			char *nb;
++
++			while (ncap &lt; len + (size_t)n + 1)
++				ncap *= 2;
++			if (ncap &gt; 8 * 1024 * 1024)
++				break;
++			nb = realloc(body, ncap);
++			if (!nb)
++				break;
++			body = nb;
++			cap = ncap;
++		}
++		memcpy(body + len, chunk, (size_t)n);
++		len += (size_t)n;
++		body[len] = '\0';
++	}
++	close(fd);
++	if (!body || len &lt; 12) {
++		free(body);
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "empty response");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	return http_strip_headers(body, len, out_status);
++}
++
++/* Retry tls_read/write through WANT_POLLIN/WANT_POLLOUT (same as gemini). */
++static ssize_t lab_tls_read(struct tls *t, void *buf, size_t len)
++{
++	int waited = 0;
++
++	for (;;) {
++		ssize_t n = tls_read(t, buf, len);
++
++		if (n == TLS_WANT_POLLIN || n == TLS_WANT_POLLOUT) {
++			struct timespec ts = { .tv_sec = 0,
++					      .tv_nsec = 5 * 1000 * 1000 };
++
++			if (waited &gt;= LAB_IO_TIMEOUT_MS)
++				return -1;
++			nanosleep(&amp;ts, NULL);
++			waited += 5;
++			continue;
++		}
++		return n;
++	}
++}
++
++static ssize_t lab_tls_write(struct tls *t, const void *buf, size_t len)
++{
++	int waited = 0;
++	const char *p = buf;
++	size_t left = len;
++
++	while (left &gt; 0) {
++		ssize_t n = tls_write(t, p, left);
++
++		if (n == TLS_WANT_POLLIN || n == TLS_WANT_POLLOUT) {
++			struct timespec ts = { .tv_sec = 0,
++					      .tv_nsec = 5 * 1000 * 1000 };
++
++			if (waited &gt;= LAB_IO_TIMEOUT_MS)
++				return -1;
++			nanosleep(&amp;ts, NULL);
++			waited += 5;
++			continue;
++		}
++		if (n &lt; 0)
++			return n;
++		if (n == 0)
++			return (ssize_t)(len - left);
++		p += n;
++		left -= (size_t)n;
++		waited = 0;
++	}
++	return (ssize_t)len;
++}
++
++/* HTTPS GET via libtls. Returns malloc body or NULL. */
++static char *https_get(const char *url, int *out_status, char *err, size_t errlen)
++{
++	char host[256], path[512], portstr[16], req[1024];
++	int port = 443;
++	struct tls_config *cfg = NULL;
++	struct tls *ctx_tls = NULL;
++	char *body = NULL;
++	size_t cap = 0, len = 0;
++	char chunk[4096];
++	ssize_t n;
++
++	if (err &amp;&amp; errlen)
++		err[0] = '\0';
++	if (out_status)
++		*out_status = 0;
++	if (parse_http_url(url, 1, host, sizeof(host), path, sizeof(path),
++			   &amp;port) != 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "bad https URL");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (tls_init() == -1) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_init failed");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	cfg = tls_config_new();
++	if (!cfg) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_config_new failed");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	/* Match gemini: allow typical self-signed / incomplete chains for now. */
++	tls_config_insecure_noverifycert(cfg);
++	tls_config_insecure_noverifyname(cfg);
++
++	ctx_tls = tls_client();
++	if (!ctx_tls) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_client failed");
++		tls_config_free(cfg);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (tls_configure(ctx_tls, cfg) == -1) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_configure: %s",
++				 tls_error(ctx_tls) ? tls_error(ctx_tls) : "?");
++		tls_free(ctx_tls);
++		tls_config_free(cfg);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	snprintf(portstr, sizeof(portstr), "%d", port);
++	if (tls_connect(ctx_tls, host, portstr) == -1) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_connect %s:%s: %s", host,
++				 portstr,
++				 tls_error(ctx_tls) ? tls_error(ctx_tls) : "?");
++		tls_free(ctx_tls);
++		tls_config_free(cfg);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++
++	snprintf(req, sizeof(req),
++		 "GET %s HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: %s\r\nUser-Agent: Labyrinth/0.1 "
++		 "(BGTK)\r\nAccept: text/html,*/*\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
++		 path, host);
++	if (lab_tls_write(ctx_tls, req, strlen(req)) &lt; 0) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_write: %s",
++				 tls_error(ctx_tls) ? tls_error(ctx_tls) : "?");
++		tls_close(ctx_tls);
++		tls_free(ctx_tls);
++		tls_config_free(cfg);
++		return NULL;
++	}
++
++	for (;;) {
++		n = lab_tls_read(ctx_tls, chunk, sizeof(chunk));
++		if (n &lt; 0) {
++			if (err &amp;&amp; !body)
++				snprintf(err, errlen, "tls_read: %s",
++					 tls_error(ctx_tls) ? tls_error(ctx_tls)
++							    : "?");
++			break;
++		}
++		if (n == 0)
++			break;
++		if (len + (size_t)n + 1 &gt; cap) {
++			size_t ncap = cap ? cap * 2 : 8192;
++			char *nb;
++
++			while (ncap &lt; len + (size_t)n + 1)
++				ncap *= 2;
++			if (ncap &gt; 8 * 1024 * 1024)
++				break;
++			nb = realloc(body, ncap);
++			if (!nb)
++				break;
++			body = nb;
++			cap = ncap;
++		}
++		memcpy(body + len, chunk, (size_t)n);
++		len += (size_t)n;
++		body[len] = '\0';
++	}
++	tls_close(ctx_tls);
++	tls_free(ctx_tls);
++	tls_config_free(cfg);
++
++	if (!body || len &lt; 12) {
++		free(body);
++		if (err &amp;&amp; !err[0])
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "empty HTTPS response");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	return http_strip_headers(body, len, out_status);
++}
++
++static char *wrap_http_error(int st, char *body)
++{
++	char *wrap;
++	size_t n;
++
++	if (!body)
++		return NULL;
++	if (st &lt; 400)
++		return body;
++	n = strlen(body) + 128;
++	wrap = malloc(n);
++	if (!wrap)
++		return body;
++	snprintf(wrap, n,
++		 "&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;&lt;h1&gt;HTTP %d&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;pre&gt;%s&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;", st,
++		 body);
++	free(body);
++	return wrap;
++}
++
++static char *fetch_document(const char *url, char *err, size_t errlen)
++{
++	if (!url || !url[0]) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "empty URL");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (!strcmp(url, "about:home") || !strcmp(url, "about://home"))
++		return strdup(HOME_HTML);
++	if (!strcmp(url, "about:blank") || !strcmp(url, "about://blank"))
++		return strdup(BLANK_HTML);
++	if (!strncmp(url, "about:", 6)) {
++		if (err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "unknown about: page");
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	if (!strncmp(url, "file://", 7)) {
++		const char *path = url + 7;
++		char *body;
++
++		/* file:///path → /path */
++		if (path[0] == '/' &amp;&amp; path[1] == '/')
++			path += 1;
++		body = read_file_all(path, NULL);
++		if (!body &amp;&amp; err)
++			snprintf(err, errlen, "cannot read %s", path);
++		return body;
++	}
++	if (!strncmp(url, "https://", 8)) {
++		int st = 0;
++		char *body = https_get(url, &amp;st, err, errlen);
++
++		return wrap_http_error(st, body);
++	}
++	if (!strncmp(url, "http://", 7)) {
++		int st = 0;
++		char *body = http_get(url, &amp;st, err, errlen);
++
++		return wrap_http_error(st, body);
++	}
++	if (err)
++		snprintf(err, errlen,
++			 "unsupported scheme (try https: http: file: about:)");
++	return NULL;
++}
++

++/* Document load / display                                            */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void set_addr_bar(const char *url)
++{
++	if (!addr_input)
++		return;
++	free(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text = strdup(url ? url : "");
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos =
++		(uint32_t)strlen(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.scroll_x = 0;
++}
++
++static void show_message_page(const char *title, const char *detail)
++{
++	char html[2048];
++	struct BGTK_Widget *page, *old;
++
++	snprintf(html, sizeof(html),
++		 "&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;&lt;h1&gt;%s&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;%s&lt;/p&gt;"
++		 "&lt;p&gt;Enter another URL in the bar below.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;",
++		 title ? title : "Error", detail ? detail : "");
++	labyrinth_layout_chrome();
++	page = bgtk_html_parse_inline(ctx, html, content_w, content_h);
++	old = content_host-&gt;data.frame.child;
++	content_host-&gt;data.frame.child = page;
++	if (page)
++		bgtk_widget_set_parent(page, content_host);
++	if (old)
++		bgtk_widget_destroy(old);
++	free(last_html);
++	last_html = strdup(html);
++}
++
++static void load_html_string(const char *html)
++{
++	struct BGTK_Widget *page, *old;
++
++	if (!html)
++		html = BLANK_HTML;
++
++	labyrinth_scan_pipeline(html);
++	labyrinth_layout_chrome();
++
++	page = bgtk_html_parse_inline(ctx, html, content_w, content_h);
++	if (!page) {
++		show_message_page("Parse error", "Could not build widget tree from HTML.");
++		return;
++	}
++
++	/* Planned stages — currently no-ops. */
++	labyrinth_css_apply(page, html);
++	labyrinth_js_boot(page, html);
++	labyrinth_wire_links(page, html);
++
++	old = content_host-&gt;data.frame.child;
++	content_host-&gt;data.frame.child = page;
++	bgtk_widget_set_parent(page, content_host);
++	if (old)
++		bgtk_widget_destroy(old);
++
++	free(last_html);
++	last_html = strdup(html);
++}
++
++static void load_url(const char *url)
++{
++	char err[256];
++	char *html;
++
++	if (!url || !url[0])
++		return;
++	snprintf(current_url, sizeof(current_url), "%s", url);
++	set_addr_bar(current_url);
++	bgtk_log("labyrinth load %s", current_url);
++
++	html = fetch_document(current_url, err, sizeof(err));
++	if (!html) {
++		show_message_page("Load failed", err[0] ? err : "unknown error");
++		if (ctx)
++			bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++		return;
++	}
++	load_html_string(html);
++	free(html);
++	if (ctx) {
++		/* Prefer focusing content so j/k scroll the page. */
++		if (content_host &amp;&amp; content_host-&gt;data.frame.child) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *page =
++				content_host-&gt;data.frame.child;
++			struct BGTK_Widget *sc =
++				(page-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_FRAME)
++					? page-&gt;data.frame.child
++					: page;
++
++			if (sc &amp;&amp; sc-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE)
++				bgtk_set_focus(ctx, sc);
++			else
++				bgtk_set_focus(ctx, content_host);
++		}
++		bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	}
++}
++
++static void navigate(const char *url, int push)
++{
++	char full[768];
++
++	if (!url || !url[0])
++		return;
++	/* Bare host → http:// */
++	if (strncmp(url, "http://", 7) != 0 &amp;&amp;
++	    strncmp(url, "https://", 8) != 0 &amp;&amp;
++	    strncmp(url, "file://", 7) != 0 &amp;&amp;
++	    strncmp(url, "about:", 6) != 0) {
++		snprintf(full, sizeof(full), "http://%s", url);
++		url = full;
++	}
++	if (push &amp;&amp; current_url[0])
++		hist_push(current_url);
++	load_url(url);
++}
++
++static void addr_on_enter(void)
++{
++	if (!addr_input || !addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text)
++		return;
++	navigate(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text, 1);
++}
++
++#ifndef LABYRINTH_TEST_MODE
++static void labyrinth_on_resize(void)
++{
++	labyrinth_layout_chrome();
++	if (last_html)
++		load_html_string(last_html);
++	else if (content_host &amp;&amp; content_host-&gt;data.frame.child) {
++		content_host-&gt;data.frame.child-&gt;w = content_w;
++		content_host-&gt;data.frame.child-&gt;h = content_h;
++	}
++}
++

++/* Focus helpers                                                      */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *content_scroll_widget(void)
++{
++	struct BGTK_Widget *page;
++
++	if (!content_host)
++		return NULL;
++	page = content_host-&gt;data.frame.child;
++	if (!page)
++		return NULL;
++	if (page-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_FRAME &amp;&amp; page-&gt;data.frame.child &amp;&amp;
++	    page-&gt;data.frame.child-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE)
++		return page-&gt;data.frame.child;
++	if (page-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE)
++		return page;
++	return NULL;
++}
++
++#endif

++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Main                                                               */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++#ifndef LABYRINTH_TEST_MODE
++
++int main(void)
++{
++	int width = 720, height = 520;
++	int conn_fd;
++	struct BufferRequest req;
++	void *buffer;
++	struct BGTK_Widget *main_items[2];
++	struct BGTK_Widget *placeholder;
++	struct BGCEMessage msg;
++	ssize_t bytes;
++	const char *quit_reason = "unknown";
++	int pad, fmar, bw;
++
++	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
++	setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
++	bgtk_log_open("labyrinth");
++	signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
++	bgtk_log("labyrinth starting pid=%ld", (long)getpid());
++
++	if (tls_init() == -1) {
++		bgtk_log("tls_init failed — is libtls/libretls installed?");
++		return 1;
++	}
++	bgtk_log("tls_init ok");
++
++	conn_fd = bgce_connect();
++	if (conn_fd &lt; 0) {
++		bgtk_log_errno("bgce_connect (is bgce running?)");
++		return 1;
++	}
++	req.width = (uint32_t)width;
++	req.height = (uint32_t)height;
++	buffer = bgce_get_buffer(conn_fd, req);
++	if (!buffer) {
++		bgtk_log("bgce_get_buffer %dx%d failed", width, height);
++		bgce_disconnect(conn_fd);
++		return 1;
++	}
++	ctx = bgtk_init(conn_fd, buffer, width, height);
++	if (!ctx) {
++		bgtk_log("bgtk_init failed");
++		bgce_disconnect(conn_fd);
++		return 1;
++	}
++
++	labyrinth_chrome(&amp;pad, &amp;fmar, &amp;bw);
++	addr_input = bgtk_text_input(
++		ctx, current_url, 200, 0,
++		(BGTK_Options){.padding = pad &gt; 4 ? pad / 2 : 4, .margin = 0});
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.on_enter = addr_on_enter;
++
++	placeholder = bgtk_text(ctx, "Loading…",
++				(BGTK_Options){.padding = 8, .margin = 4});
++	content_host = bgtk_frame(ctx, placeholder, 100, 100,
++				  (BGTK_Options){.padding = 0, .margin = 0});
++	if (content_host)
++		content_host-&gt;data.frame.border_w = 0;
++
++	main_items[0] = content_host;
++	main_items[1] = addr_input;
++	main_list = bgtk_list(ctx, main_items, 2,
++			      (BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_VERTICAL,
++					     .padding = 0,
++					     .margin = 0});
++	root_frame = bgtk_frame(ctx, main_list, width, height,
++				(BGTK_Options){.padding = pad, .margin = fmar});
++	ctx-&gt;root_widget = root_frame;
++	labyrinth_layout_chrome();
++
++	{
++		struct BGTK_Widget *sc = content_scroll_widget();
++
++		bgtk_set_focus(ctx, sc ? sc : content_host);
++	}
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	load_url(current_url);
++
++	bgtk_log("entering main loop %dx%d url=%s", width, height, current_url);
++	while (1) {
++		bytes = bgce_recv_msg(ctx-&gt;conn_fd, &amp;msg);
++		if (bytes &lt;= 0) {
++			if (bytes == 0)
++				quit_reason = "server closed connection";
++			else if (errno == EINTR)
++				continue;
++			else
++				quit_reason = "recv error";
++			break;
++		}
++		switch (msg.type) {
++		case MSG_INPUT_EVENT: {
++			struct InputEvent *ev = &amp;msg.data.input_event;
++			int res = 0;
++
++			if (ev-&gt;type == EV_ABS)
++				break;
++			if (ev-&gt;type == EV_REL &amp;&amp; ev-&gt;code != REL_WHEEL)
++				break;
++
++			bgtk_update_modifiers(ctx, *ev);
++
++			if (ev-&gt;type == EV_KEY &amp;&amp;
++			    (ev-&gt;value == 1 || ev-&gt;value == 2)) {
++				int addr_focus =
++					(ctx-&gt;focused_widget == addr_input);
++				int mods = bgtk_mods_from_ctx(ctx);
++				int scroll_key = 0;
++				char prev[768];
++				struct BGTK_Widget *sc;
++
++				if (((mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_L) ||
++				    (!addr_focus &amp;&amp; !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_SHIFT) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_O)) {
++					bgtk_set_focus(ctx, addr_input);
++					res = 1;
++					break;
++				}
++				if (((mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_R) ||
++				    (!addr_focus &amp;&amp; !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_SHIFT) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_R)) {
++					load_url(current_url);
++					res = 1;
++					break;
++				}
++				if (ev-&gt;code == KEY_ESC) {
++					if (addr_focus) {
++						sc = content_scroll_widget();
++						bgtk_set_focus(
++							ctx,
++							sc ? sc : content_host);
++						res = 1;
++						break;
++					}
++					quit_reason = "Esc";
++					goto done;
++				}
++				if (((mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_C) ||
++				    (!addr_focus &amp;&amp; !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				     ev-&gt;code == KEY_Q)) {
++					quit_reason = "quit key";
++					goto done;
++				}
++				if (!addr_focus &amp;&amp; !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				    ev-&gt;code == KEY_B) {
++					if (hist_back(prev, sizeof(prev)))
++						load_url(prev);
++					res = 1;
++					break;
++				}
++				if (!addr_focus &amp;&amp; !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_CTRL) &amp;&amp;
++				    !(mods &amp; BGTK_MOD_SHIFT) &amp;&amp;
++				    ev-&gt;code == KEY_H) {
++					navigate("about:home", 1);
++					res = 1;
++					break;
++				}
++				if (ev-&gt;code == KEY_PAGEUP ||
++				    ev-&gt;code == KEY_PAGEDOWN)
++					scroll_key = 1;
++				else if (!addr_focus &amp;&amp;
++					 (ev-&gt;code == KEY_UP ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_DOWN ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_HOME ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_END ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_SPACE ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_J ||
++					  ev-&gt;code == KEY_K))
++					scroll_key = 1;
++				if (scroll_key) {
++					sc = content_scroll_widget();
++					if (sc &amp;&amp; sc-&gt;handle_event &amp;&amp;
++					    sc-&gt;handle_event(sc, *ev))
++						res = 1;
++					break;
++				}
++			}
++
++			if (!res)
++				res = bgtk_handle_input_event(ctx, *ev);
++			if (res)
++				bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++			break;
++		}
++		case MSG_FOCUS_CHANGE:
++			bgtk_set_window_focus(ctx, msg.data.focus_event.state);
++			break;
++		case MSG_BUFFER_CHANGE:
++			if (bgtk_handle_buffer_change(
++				    ctx, &amp;msg.data.buffer_reply) == 0) {
++				labyrinth_on_resize();
++				bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++			}
++			break;
++		default:
++			break;
++		}
++	}
++done:
++	bgtk_log("labyrinth exit: %s", quit_reason);
++	free(last_html);
++	bgtk_destroy(ctx);
++	bgce_disconnect(conn_fd);
++	return 0;
++}
++
++#endif /* LABYRINTH_TEST_MODE */
++

++	"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;";
++
++int main(void)
++{
++	int width = 720, height = 520;
++	struct BGTK_Context *ctx;
++	uint32_t *fb;

++

++		fprintf(stderr, "test_labyrinth: init failed\n");
++		return 1;
++	}
++	bgtk_log_open("test_labyrinth");
++	labyrinth_test_init(ctx, width, height);
++
++	/* 00: about:home */
++	labyrinth_test_load("about:home");
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "labyrinth_00_home.png");
++
++	fb = (uint32_t *)ctx-&gt;shm_buffer;
++	bg = ctx-&gt;theme.background | 0xFF000000u;
++	bright = 0;
++	for (i = 0; i &lt; width * height; i++) {
++		if (fb[i] != 0 &amp;&amp; fb[i] != bg)
++			bright++;
++	}
++	if (bright &lt; 100) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "test_labyrinth: home page empty (bright=%d)\n",
++			bright);
++		bgtk_destroy_mock(ctx);
++		return 1;
++	}
++	if (strcmp(labyrinth_test_url(), "about:home") != 0) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "test_labyrinth: url want about:home got %s\n",
++			labyrinth_test_url());
++		bgtk_destroy_mock(ctx);
++		return 1;
++	}
++
++	/* 01: inline HTML sample */
++	labyrinth_test_load_html(SAMPLE);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "labyrinth_01_inline_html.png");
++
++	/* 02: focus URL bar (bottom) — click lower strip */
++	click.type = EV_KEY;
++	click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++	click.value = 1;
++	click.x = width / 2;
++	click.y = height - 36;
++	bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	click.value = 0;
++	bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "labyrinth_02_url_focused.png");
++
++	/* 03: about:blank */
++	labyrinth_test_load("about:blank");
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "labyrinth_03_blank.png");
++
++	/* 04: back to home via load (history not required) */
++	labyrinth_test_load("about:home");
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "labyrinth_04_home_again.png");
++
++	printf("test_labyrinth complete. PNG frames written.\n");
++	bgtk_destroy_mock(ctx);
++	return 0;
++}

+    borderless frames/tables, text baseline options, and dual-stack IPv6
+    network probes. Settings loads full bgce.conf (bg/cursors/shortcuts),

++/* Write [cursors] theme into bgce.conf (merge, keep other sections). */
++static void write_bgce_cursors(void)
++{
++	const char *home = getenv("HOME");
++	char path[512], tmp[512], dir[512];
++	FILE *in, *out;
++	char line[512];
++	char section[64] = "";
++	int wrote = 0;
++
++	if (!home || !home[0])
++		return;
++	if (cursor_path_input &amp;&amp; cursor_path_input-&gt;data.text_input.text) {
++		strncpy(cursor_theme, cursor_path_input-&gt;data.text_input.text,
++			MAX_PATH_LEN - 1);
++		cursor_theme[MAX_PATH_LEN - 1] = '\0';
++	}
++	snprintf(dir, sizeof(dir), "%s/.config", home);
++	(void)mkdir(dir, 0755);
++	snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/.config/bgce.conf", home);
++	snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s/.config/bgce.conf.bgtk-tmp", home);
++	in = fopen(path, "r");
++	out = fopen(tmp, "w");
++	if (!out) {
++		if (in)
++			fclose(in);
++		return;
++	}
++	if (in) {
++		int skip = 0;
++		while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), in)) {
++			char *p = line;
++			while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t')
++				p++;
++			if (*p == '[') {
++				char *end = strchr(p, ']');
++				section[0] = '\0';
++				if (end &amp;&amp;
++				    (size_t)(end - p - 1) &lt; sizeof(section)) {
++					memcpy(section, p + 1,
++					       (size_t)(end - p - 1));
++					section[end - p - 1] = '\0';
++				}
++				if (strcmp(section, "cursors") == 0) {
++					skip = 1;
++					continue;
++				}
++				if (skip) {
++					fprintf(out, "[cursors]\n");
++					if (cursor_theme[0])
++						fprintf(out, "theme = %s\n",

++					fprintf(out, "\n");
++					wrote = 1;
++					skip = 0;
++				}
++				fputs(line, out);
++				continue;
++			}
++			if (skip)
++				continue;
++			fputs(line, out);

++		if (skip) {
++			fprintf(out, "[cursors]\n");
++			if (cursor_theme[0])

+-/* Non-blocking-ish TCP connect with short timeout to a public DNS. */
+-static void metric_internet(char *out, size_t n)
++/*
++ * Internet / weather need only libc networking (no curl/libtls):
++ *   - Internet: dual-stack TCP :80 via getaddrinfo (IPv4 + IPv6)
++ *   - Weather: DNS + HTTP/1.0 :80 to wttr.in (AF_UNSPEC)
++ * No package deps. IPv6-only boards must not hardcode 1.1.1.1.
++ */
++/* 0 ok, -1 fail, -2 timeout */
++static int tcp_probe_ai(const struct addrinfo *rp, long *out_ms)
+ {
+-	int fd;

+-	struct timeval tv;
+-	long ms;
+ 
+-	fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
+-	if (fd &lt; 0) {
+-		snprintf(out, n, "offline (socket)");
+-		return;
+-	}
++	fd = socket(rp-&gt;ai_family, rp-&gt;ai_socktype, rp-&gt;ai_protocol);

++{

++
++struct BGTK_Widget *bgtk_rule(struct BGTK_Context *ctx,
++			      enum BGTK_List_Orientation orientation,
++			      int thickness, BGTK_Options options)
++{
++	struct BGTK_Widget *w = widget_new(ctx, BGTK_WIDGET_RULE, options);
++	if (!w)
++		return NULL;
++	if (thickness &lt; 1)
++		thickness = 1;
++	w-&gt;data.rule.orientation = orientation;
++	w-&gt;data.rule.thickness = thickness;
++	w-&gt;data.rule.color = 0;
++	w-&gt;handle_event = rule_handle_event;
++	if (orientation == BGTK_LIST_VERTICAL) {
++		w-&gt;w = thickness + 2 * (w-&gt;padding + w-&gt;margin);
++		w-&gt;h = thickness + 2 * (w-&gt;padding + w-&gt;margin);
++	} else {
++		w-&gt;w = thickness + 2 * (w-&gt;padding + w-&gt;margin);
++		w-&gt;h = thickness + 2 * (w-&gt;padding + w-&gt;margin);
++	}
++	return w;
++}

+parent <a href=commit-43fbd0f.html>43fbd0f</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-06T19:43:05-03:00
+
+    fix: avoid strncpy overlap crash in bgtk_log_open.
+
+    bgtk_log_ensure reopened the log with bgtk_log_name as the app name,
+    which strncpy'd the buffer onto itself and aborted under fortify.
+
+<a href=tree-b4dc489.html>tree</a>
+
+<b>diff</b>
+
+diff --git a/bgtk.c b/bgtk.c
+index a3defe8..3f91552 100644
+--- a/bgtk.c
++++ b/bgtk.c
+@@ -82,7 +82,8 @@ void bgtk_log_open(const char *app_name)
+ 	char dir[512];
+ 	char path[640];
+ 
+-	if (app_name &amp;&amp; app_name[0]) {
++	/* Avoid strncpy(dst, dst) when ensure() reopens with bgtk_log_name. */
++	if (app_name &amp;&amp; app_name[0] &amp;&amp; app_name != bgtk_log_name) {
+ 		strncpy(bgtk_log_name, app_name, sizeof(bgtk_log_name) - 1);
+ 		bgtk_log_name[sizeof(bgtk_log_name) - 1] = '\0';
+ 	}
+</pre>

+@@ -12,6 +12,16 @@ create graphical user interfaces by directly writing to a shared graphical buffe
+ - Theme support via config files (e.g., colors, fonts).
+ 
+ 
++## Available Widgets
++- Text: bgtk_text(ctx, text, options)
++- Label: bgtk_label(ctx, text, options)
++- Button: bgtk_button(ctx, label_widget, callback, options)
++- Scrollable: bgtk_scrollable(ctx, items, widget_count, options)
++- Image: bgtk_image(ctx, path, options)
++- Frame: bgtk_frame(ctx, child, width, height, options)
++- Text input: bgtk_text_input(ctx, initial_text, width, height, options)
++
++
+ ## Themes
+ Theme config files allow customizing the appearance of BGTK applications.
+ To use a theme:

+--- a/bgtk.h

+ 	} data;
+diff --git a/drawing.c b/drawing.c
+index 9acefed..c819800 100644
+--- a/drawing.c
++++ b/drawing.c
+@@ -123,23 +123,11 @@ void calculate_widget_size(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, struct BGTK_Widget* w) {
+ 		case BGTK_WIDGET_IMAGE:
+ 			// the widget must have a definite size
+ 			break;
+-		case BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT_INPUT: {
+-			// Calculate size based on text content (or use fixed
+-			// width/height)
+-			int text_w, text_h;
+-			measure_text(ctx-&gt;ft_face, w-&gt;data.text_input.text,
+-				     &amp;text_w, &amp;text_h);
+-			// Ensure minimum width/height (e.g., 100px)
+-			w-&gt;w = text_w + 2 * w-&gt;padding;
+-			w-&gt;h = text_h + 2 * w-&gt;padding;
+-			if (w-&gt;w &lt; 100) {
+-				w-&gt;w = 100;
+-			}
+-			if (w-&gt;h &lt; 20) {
+-				w-&gt;h = 20;
+-			}
++		case BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT_INPUT:
++			// Text input is a fixed-size widget; its size is set by
++			// the constructor (bgtk_text_input). Do not resize
++			// based on content.
+ 			break;
+-		}
+ 		default:

+commit b7640b6
+parent <a href=commit-8f0bef5.html>8f0bef5</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-06T16:07:38-03:00
+
+    fix: terminal window resize and safe launcher process spawn.
+
+    Terminal handles MSG_BUFFER_CHANGE: remount buffer, term_resize the
+    cell grid, reallocate the image surface, TIOCSWINSZ the PTY, redraw.
+    Launcher no longer exit()s after fork or leaves the BGCE socket in the
+    child — close inherited fds, setsid, and keep the launcher running.
+
+<a href=tree-b7640b6.html>tree</a>
+
+<b>diff</b>
+
+diff --git a/apps/launcher.c b/apps/launcher.c

++++ b/apps/launcher.c
+@@ -2,7 +2,9 @@
+ #include &lt;bgtk.h&gt;

++#include &lt;fcntl.h&gt;
+ #include &lt;linux/input.h&gt;
++#include &lt;signal.h&gt;
+ #include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
+ #include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
+ #include &lt;string.h&gt;
+@@ -140,17 +142,50 @@ static void on_tab_pressed(void)
+ 	rebuild_matches_ui();
+ }
+ 
+-static void on_enter_pressed(void)
++/* Spawn a program without inheriting the launcher's BGCE socket (or any
++ * other fds). Inheriting the compositor connection and then exit()'ing the
++ * parent was crashing the session when launching apps. */
++static void spawn_program(const char *prog)
+ {
+-	if (selected &lt; 0 || selected &gt;= num_matches)
+-		return;
+-	const char* prog = match_ptrs[selected];
+ 	pid_t pid = fork();
++	if (pid &lt; 0) {
++		bgtk_log_errno("fork to launch '%s'", prog);
++		return;
++	}
+ 	if (pid == 0) {
+-		execlp(prog, prog, (char*)NULL);
+-		_exit(126);
++		/* New session: not a child of the launcher process group. */
++		setsid();
++
++		/* Drop every fd the parent had open (BGCE socket, shm, …). */
++		int maxfd = (int)sysconf(_SC_OPEN_MAX);
++		if (maxfd &lt; 0 || maxfd &gt; 1024)
++			maxfd = 256;
++		for (int fd = 3; fd &lt; maxfd; fd++)
++			(void)close(fd);
++
++		/* Quiet stdio so GUI apps don't fight over the TTY. */
++		int devnull = open("/dev/null", O_RDWR);
++		if (devnull &gt;= 0) {
++			dup2(devnull, STDIN_FILENO);
++			dup2(devnull, STDOUT_FILENO);
++			dup2(devnull, STDERR_FILENO);
++			if (devnull &gt; 2)
++				close(devnull);
++		}
++
++		execlp(prog, prog, (char *)NULL);
++		/* exec failed — cannot log (fds closed); hard-exit. */
++		_exit(127);
+ 	}
+-	exit(0);
++	/* Parent keeps running as the launcher. */
++	bgtk_log("spawned '%s' as pid=%ld", prog, (long)pid);
++}
++
++static void on_enter_pressed(void)
++{
++	if (selected &lt; 0 || selected &gt;= num_matches)
++		return;
++	spawn_program(match_ptrs[selected]);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Size input + match list to fill the current window. */

++	/* Avoid zombies from spawned apps. */
++	signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_IGN);

+

+-static char *build_background_html(void)
+-{
+-	/* Values come from load_bgce_config / cfg (desktop = bgce.conf). */
+-	char color_hex[16];
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.color, color_hex, sizeof(color_hex));
+-
+-	char *buf = malloc(4096);
+-	int pos = 0;
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, 4096 - pos,
+-		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
+-		"&lt;table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Type&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;[ %s ]&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;",
+-		cfg.type == BG_IMAGE ? "Image" : "Color");
+-
+-	if (cfg.type == BG_COLOR) {
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, 4096 - pos,
+-			"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Color&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"120\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;",
+-			color_hex);
+-	} else {
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, 4096 - pos,
+-			"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Path&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"280\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-			"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Mode&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;[ %s ]&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;",
+-			cfg.path[0] ? cfg.path : "",
+-			cfg.mode == IMAGE_SCALED ? "Scaled" : "Tiled");
+-	}
+-
+-	/* Preview inserted by add_bg_preview before Apply. */
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, 4096 - pos,
+-		"&lt;/table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;");
+-	return buf;
+-}
+-
+-static char *build_cursor_html(void)
+-{
+-	char **cursors = NULL;
+-	int ncursors = scan_cursors(&amp;cursors);
+-	const char *cur = cursor_theme[0] ? cursor_theme : "";
+-
+-	int buflen = 4096 + ncursors * 256;
+-	char *buf = malloc(buflen);
+-	int pos = 0;
+-
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
+-		"&lt;table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Theme&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"260\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;p&gt;Installed themes&lt;/p&gt;"
+-		"&lt;ul&gt;",
+-		cur);
+-
+-	if (ncursors == 0) {
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-			"&lt;li&gt;No cursor themes found in system paths&lt;/li&gt;");
+-	}
+-	for (int i = 0; i &lt; ncursors; i++) {
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-			"&lt;li&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/li&gt;", cursors[i]);
+-		free(cursors[i]);
+-	}
+-	free(cursors);
+-
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-		"&lt;/ul&gt;"
+-		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;");
+-
+-	return buf;
+-}
+-
+-static char *build_shortcuts_html(void)
+-{
+-	char *buf;
+-	int buflen = 2048 + shortcut_row_count * 256;
+-	int pos = 0;
+-	int i;
+-
+-	if (!shortcut_row_count)
+-		load_shortcuts_table();
+-
+-	buf = malloc((size_t)buflen);
+-	if (!buf)
+-		return NULL;
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, (size_t)(buflen - pos),
+-		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
+-		"&lt;table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Action&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Key binding&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;");
+-	for (i = 0; i &lt; shortcut_row_count; i++) {
+-		const char *label = shortcut_labels[i][0]
+-					    ? shortcut_labels[i]
+-					    : shortcut_actions[i];
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, (size_t)(buflen - pos),
+-			"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;%s&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" "
+-			"width=\"160\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;",
+-			label, shortcut_keys[i]);
+-	}
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, (size_t)(buflen - pos),
+-		"&lt;/table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;");
+-	(void)pos;
+-	return buf;
+-}
+-
+-static char *build_font_html(void)
+-{
+-	const char *sans_name = font_basename(cfg.font_sans_path);
+-	const char *mono_name = font_basename(cfg.font_mono_path);
+-	const char *serif_name = font_basename(cfg.font_serif_path);
+-	const char *open_label = "";
+-	int buflen = 8192 + font_list_count * 256;
+-	char *buf = malloc(buflen);
+-	int pos = 0;
+-
+-	if (!buf)
+-		return NULL;
+-	if (font_dropdown_open) {
+-		if (font_pick_role == BGTK_FONT_MONO)
+-			open_label = " (picking mono)";
+-		else if (font_pick_role == BGTK_FONT_SERIF)
+-			open_label = " (picking serif)";
+-		else
+-			open_label = " (picking sans)";
+-	}
+-
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
+-		"&lt;table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Sans (UI)&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Mono&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Serif&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%d\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/table&gt;",
+-		sans_name, mono_name, serif_name, cfg.font_size);
+-
+-	/* Dropdown list for the active role (only when open). */
+-	if (font_dropdown_open) {
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos, "&lt;p&gt;Fonts%s:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;",
+-				open_label);
+-		int show = font_list_count &gt; 50 ? 50 : font_list_count;
+-		for (int i = 0; i &lt; show; i++) {
+-			const char *name = strrchr(font_list_cache[i], '/');
+-			name = name ? name + 1 : font_list_cache[i];
+-			pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-				"&lt;li&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/li&gt;", name);
+-		}
+-		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos, "&lt;/ul&gt;");
+-	}
+-
+-	/* Preview (rendered with the active UI/sans face). */
+-	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
+-		"&lt;p&gt;Preview:&lt;/p&gt;"
+-		"&lt;p&gt;The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog&lt;/p&gt;"
+-		"&lt;p&gt;ABCDEFGHIJKLM 0123456789 !@#$%%&lt;/p&gt;"
+-		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;");
+-
+-	return buf;
+-}

+-/*
+- * Theme page: 4-column table (label|value|label|value).
+- * Left pair = surfaces/fills; right pair = borders + spacing + text.
+- * get_input() order is document order L→R, top→bottom.
+- */
+-static char *build_theme_html(void)
+-{
+-	char bg[16], btn[16], btxt[16], fbc[16], foc[16], fbg[16], ibg[16],
+-		hi[16];
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.background, bg, sizeof(bg));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.button, btn, sizeof(btn));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.button_text, btxt, sizeof(btxt));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.frame_border_color, fbc, sizeof(fbc));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.focus, foc, sizeof(foc));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.focus_bg, fbg, sizeof(fbg));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.input_bg, ibg, sizeof(ibg));
+-	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.highlight, hi, sizeof(hi));
+-
+-	char *buf = malloc(8192);
+-	if (!buf)
+-		return NULL;
+-	/* iw = input width; shorter for numeric fields. */
+-	snprintf(buf, 8192,
+-		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
+-		"&lt;table&gt;"
+-		/* Surfaces | Borders */
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Background&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Frame border color&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Button&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Focus&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Button text&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Frame border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Input background&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Button border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Focus background&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Input border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Highlight&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"90\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Widget margin&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%d\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		/* Spacing / text (right column only continues) */
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;Frame padding&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%d\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;td&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;/td&gt;"

+-		"&lt;/tr&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/table&gt;"
+-		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
+-		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;",
+-		/* L0 */ bg, /* R0 */ fbc,
+-		/* L1 */ btn, /* R1 */ foc,
+-		/* L2 */ btxt, /* R2 */ cfg.theme.frame_border_size,
+-		/* L3 */ ibg, /* R3 */ cfg.theme.button_border_size,

+-static int bgtk_handle_events(struct BGTK_Context* ctx) {
+-	struct BGCEMessage msg;
+-	ssize_t bytes;
+-
+-	// bgce_recv_msg is blocking. This makes the UI reactive.
+-	bytes = bgce_recv_msg(ctx-&gt;conn_fd, &amp;msg);
+-	if (bytes &lt;= 0) {
+-		if (bytes == 0) {
+-			fprintf(stderr,
+-				"bgtk_main_loop: Server closed "
+-				"connection.\n");
+-		} else if (errno != EINTR) {
+-			perror("bgtk_main_loop: bgce_recv_msg");
+-		}
+-		return -1;  // Exit loop
+-	}
+-
+-	switch (msg.type) {
+-		case MSG_INPUT_EVENT:
+-			return bgtk_handle_input_event(ctx,
+-						       &amp;msg.data.input_event);
+-		case MSG_BUFFER_CHANGE:
+-			// TODO: Handle buffer resize/move
+-			return 1;  // Redraw
+-		default:
+-			// Ignore other messages for now
+-			return 0;
+-	}
+-}
+-
+-void bgtk_main_loop(struct BGTK_Context* ctx) {
+-	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
+-	bgce_draw(ctx-&gt;conn_fd);
+-	printf("BGTK Main Loop started. Press Ctrl+C to exit.\n");
+-
+-	while (1) {
+-		int result = bgtk_handle_events(ctx);
+-		if (result == -1) {
+-			break;	// Server error/disconnection
+-		} else if (result == 1) {
+-			printf("BGTK drawing.\n");
+-			bgce_draw(ctx-&gt;conn_fd);
+-		}
+-	}
+-}

+-void bgtk_add_widget(struct BGTK_Context* ctx, struct BGTK_Widget* widget,
+-		     int x, int y, int w, int h) {
+-	if (!ctx || !widget) {
+-		return;
+-	}
+-
+-	if (ctx-&gt;widget_count &gt;= ctx-&gt;widget_capacity) {
+-		ctx-&gt;widget_capacity *= 2;
+-		struct BGTK_Widget** new_widgets =
+-		    (struct BGTK_Widget**)realloc(
+-			ctx-&gt;widgets,
+-			ctx-&gt;widget_capacity * sizeof(struct BGTK_Widget*));
+-		if (!new_widgets) {
+-			perror("realloc");
+-			// In a real app, this should be handled
+-			// better
+-			return;
+-		}
+-		ctx-&gt;widgets = new_widgets;
+-	}
+-
+-	widget-&gt;x = x;
+-	widget-&gt;y = y;
+-	widget-&gt;w = w &gt; 0 ? w : widget-&gt;w;
+-	widget-&gt;h = h &gt; 0 ? h : widget-&gt;h;
+-
+-	ctx-&gt;widgets[ctx-&gt;widget_count++] = widget;
+-}
