++/* --- URL resolution (relative links, ../ etc) --- */
++static void resolve_url(const char *base, const char *rel, char *out, size_t outlen)
++{
++	if (!rel || !*rel) {
++		strncpy(out, base, outlen - 1);
++		out[outlen - 1] = 0;
++		return;
++	}
++	if (strstr(rel, "://") || !strncmp(rel, "gemini:", 7)) {
++		strncpy(out, rel, outlen - 1);
++		out[outlen - 1] = 0;
++		return;
++	}
++
++	char bhost[256] = {0};
++	char bpath[512] = {0};
++	int bport = 1965;
++
++	const char *p = base;
++	if (!strncmp(p, "gemini://", 9))
++		p += 9;
++	const char *he = strchr(p, '/');
++	const char *pe = strchr(p, ':');
++	if (pe &amp;&amp; (!he || pe &lt; he)) {
++		int hl = (int)(pe - p);
++		if (hl &gt; 255)
++			hl = 255;
++		memcpy(bhost, p, hl);
++		bhost[hl] = 0;
++		bport = atoi(pe + 1);
++		if (he)
++			strncpy(bpath, he, sizeof(bpath) - 1);
++		else
++			strcpy(bpath, "/");
++	} else if (he) {
++		int hl = (int)(he - p);
++		memcpy(bhost, p, hl);
++		bhost[hl] = 0;
++		strncpy(bpath, he, sizeof(bpath) - 1);
++	} else {
++		strncpy(bhost, p, sizeof(bhost) - 1);
++		strcpy(bpath, "/");
++	}
++	if (!bpath[0])
++		strcpy(bpath, "/");
++
++	char portpart[32] = "";
++	if (bport != 1965)
++		snprintf(portpart, sizeof(portpart), ":%d", bport);
++
++	if (rel[0] == '/') {
++		snprintf(out, outlen, "gemini://%s%s%s", bhost, portpart, rel);
++		return;
++	}
++
++	/* relative: dirname(base) + rel, with ../ handling */
++	char dir[512];
++	strncpy(dir, bpath, sizeof(dir) - 1);
++	char *ls = strrchr(dir, '/');
++	if (ls)
++		*(ls + 1) = 0;
++	else
++		strcpy(dir, "/");
++
++	char full[1024];
++	snprintf(full, sizeof(full), "%s%s", dir, rel);
++
++	/* normalize segments */
++	char *segs[64];
++	int nseg = 0;
++	char *tmp = strdup(full);
++	char *save = NULL;
++	char *seg = strtok_r(tmp, "/", &amp;save);
++	while (seg) {
++		if (!strcmp(seg, ".") || !*seg) {
++			/* skip */
++		} else if (!strcmp(seg, "..")) {
++			if (nseg &gt; 0)
++				nseg--;
++		} else {
++			segs[nseg++] = seg;
++		}
++		seg = strtok_r(NULL, "/", &amp;save);
++	}
++
++	char norm[1024] = "/";
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; nseg; i++) {
++		strcat(norm, segs[i]);
++		if (i + 1 &lt; nseg)
++			strcat(norm, "/");
++	}
++	free(tmp);
++
++	snprintf(out, outlen, "gemini://%s%s%s", bhost, portpart, norm);
++}
++
++/* --- Gemini fetch over TLS --- */
++static int fetch_gemini(const char *req_url, int *out_status, char **out_meta, char **out_body)
++{
++	*out_status = 0;
++	*out_meta = NULL;
++	*out_body = NULL;
++
++	char host[256] = {0};
++	char path[768] = "/";
++	int port = 1965;
++
++	const char *p = req_url;
++	if (!strncmp(p, "gemini://", 9))
++		p += 9;
++	const char *he = strchr(p, '/');
++	const char *pe = strchr(p, ':');
++	if (pe &amp;&amp; (!he || pe &lt; he)) {
++		int hl = (int)(pe - p);
++		if (hl &gt; 255)
++			hl = 255;
++		memcpy(host, p, hl);
++		host[hl] = 0;
++		port = atoi(pe + 1);
++		if (he)
++			strncpy(path, he, sizeof(path) - 1);
++	} else if (he) {
++		int hl = (int)(he - p);
++		memcpy(host, p, hl);
++		host[hl] = 0;
++		strncpy(path, he, sizeof(path) - 1);
++	} else {
++		strncpy(host, p, sizeof(host) - 1);
++	}
++	if (!host[0])
++		return -1;
++	if (port &lt; 1)
++		port = 1965;
++	if (!path[0])
++		strcpy(path, "/");
++
++	/* full selector is the original req_url (spec) */
++	char selector[1024];
++	strncpy(selector, req_url, sizeof(selector) - 1);
++
++	SSL_CTX *sctx = SSL_CTX_new(TLS_client_method());
++	if (!sctx)
++		return -2;
++	SSL_CTX_set_verify(sctx, SSL_VERIFY_NONE, NULL);
++
++	int sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
++	if (sock &lt; 0) {
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -3;
++	}
++
++	struct hostent *heent = gethostbyname(host);
++	if (!heent) {
++		close(sock);
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -4;
++	}
++	struct sockaddr_in sin = {0};
++	sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
++	sin.sin_port = htons(port);
++	memcpy(&amp;sin.sin_addr, heent-&gt;h_addr_list[0], heent-&gt;h_length);
++
++	if (connect(sock, (struct sockaddr *)&amp;sin, sizeof(sin)) &lt; 0) {
++		close(sock);
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -5;
++	}
++
++	SSL *ssl = SSL_new(sctx);
++	SSL_set_fd(ssl, sock);
++	if (SSL_connect(ssl) != 1) {
++		SSL_free(ssl);
++		close(sock);
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -6;
++	}
++
++	char req[1200];
++	int rlen = snprintf(req, sizeof(req), "%s\r\n", selector);
++	if (SSL_write(ssl, req, rlen) &lt;= 0) {
++		SSL_free(ssl);
++		close(sock);
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -7;
++	}
++
++	/* read header up to first \r\n */
++	char hbuf[1024] = {0};
++	int hlen = 0;
++	while (hlen &lt; (int)sizeof(hbuf) - 1) {
++		int n = SSL_read(ssl, hbuf + hlen, 1);
++		if (n &lt;= 0)
++			break;
++		hlen += n;
++		if (hlen &gt;= 2 &amp;&amp; hbuf[hlen - 2] == '\r' &amp;&amp; hbuf[hlen - 1] == '\n')
++			break;
++	}
++	hbuf[hlen] = 0;
++
++	int status = 0;
++	char meta[512] = {0};
++	if (sscanf(hbuf, "%d %511[^\r\n]", &amp;status, meta) &lt; 1)
++		status = 59;
++	*out_status = status;
++	if (out_meta)
++		*out_meta = strdup(meta);
++
++	/* read body */
++	size_t cap = 8192;
++	size_t blen = 0;
++	char *body = malloc(cap);
++	if (!body) {
++		SSL_free(ssl);
++		close(sock);
++		SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++		return -8;
++	}
++	for (;;) {
++		char rbuf[1024];
++		int n = SSL_read(ssl, rbuf, sizeof(rbuf));
++		if (n &lt;= 0)
++			break;
++		if (blen + (size_t)n + 1 &gt; cap) {
++			cap = cap * 2 + n;
++			char *nb = realloc(body, cap);
++			if (!nb) {
++				free(body);
++				SSL_free(ssl);
++				close(sock);
++				SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++				return -8;
++			}
++			body = nb;
++		}
++		memcpy(body + blen, rbuf, n);
++		blen += n;
++	}
++	body[blen] = 0;
++	*out_body = body;
++
++	SSL_shutdown(ssl);
++	SSL_free(ssl);
++	close(sock);
++	SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++	return 0;
++}
++
++/* click handler for link text widgets */
++static int gemini_link_handler(struct BGTK_Widget *w, struct InputEvent ev)
++{
++	if (ev.code == BTN_LEFT &amp;&amp; ev.value == 1) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; num_page_links; i++) {
++			if (link_target_widgets[i] == w) {
++				load_url(link_targets[i]);
++				return 1;
++			}
++		}
++	}
++	return 0;
++}
++
++/* Simple word-wrap for long paragraphs and link labels. Returns malloc'ed array of lines (caller frees). */
++static char **wrap_text(FT_Face face, const char *text, int max_width, int *nlines)
++{
++	*nlines = 0;
++	if (!face || !text || !*text || max_width &lt; 20) return NULL;
++	char **lines = NULL;
++	int n = 0, cap = 0;
++	int len = strlen(text);
++	int i = 0;
++	while (i &lt; len) {
++		int j = i;
++		int last_space = -1;
++		int w = 0;
++		for (; j &lt; len; j++) {
++			unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)text[j];
++			if (FT_Load_Char(face, ch, FT_LOAD_DEFAULT) == 0)
++				w += face-&gt;glyph-&gt;advance.x &gt;&gt; 6;
++			if (w &gt; max_width &amp;&amp; j &gt; i) break;
++			if (isspace(ch)) last_space = j;
++		}
++		int end = (j &gt;= len) ? len : (last_space &gt; i ? last_space : j);
++		int lnlen = end - i;
++		char *ln = malloc(lnlen + 1);
++		memcpy(ln, text + i, lnlen);
++		ln[lnlen] = 0;
++		while (lnlen &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)ln[lnlen-1])) ln[--lnlen] = 0;
++		if (n &gt;= cap) {
++			cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 8;
++			lines = realloc(lines, cap * sizeof(char *));
++		}
++		lines[n++] = ln;
++		i = end;
++		while (i &lt; len &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)text[i])) i++;
++	}
++	*nlines = n;
++	return lines;
++}
++
++/* replace page content from gemtext body */
++static void rebuild_content_from_gemtext(const char *body)
++{
++	/* free old line widgets (all plain text) */
++	if (content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *tw = content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
++			if (tw) {
++				free(tw-&gt;data.text.text);
++				free(tw);
++			}
++		}
++		free(content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items);
++		content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items = NULL;
++		content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = 0;
++	}
++	num_page_links = 0;
++
++	if (!body)
++		return;
++
++	int max_text_w = 480;
++	if (content_scroll &amp;&amp; content_scroll-&gt;w &gt; 100)
++		max_text_w = content_scroll-&gt;w - 8;
++
++	/* copy for strtok */
++	char *work = strdup(body);
++	if (!work)
++		return;
++
++	/* collect new widgets */
++	struct BGTK_Widget **new_items = NULL;
++	int cap = 0;
++	int cnt = 0;
++
++	char *save = NULL;
++	char *line = strtok_r(work, "\n", &amp;save);
++	int in_pre = 0;
++	while (line) {
++		/* strip \r */
++		char *cr = strchr(line, '\r');
++		if (cr)
++			*cr = 0;
++
++		if (!strncmp(line, "```", 3)) {
++			in_pre = !in_pre;
++			line = strtok_r(NULL, "\n", &amp;save);
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		char vis[768];
++		int is_link = 0;
++		char link_to[512] = {0};
++		int header_level = 0;
++
++		if (in_pre) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "  %s", line);
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "=&gt;", 2)) {
++			/* link */
++			char tgt[512] = {0};
++			char disp[512] = {0};
++			const char *rest = line + 2;
++			while (*rest == ' ' || *rest == '\t')
++				rest++;
++			const char *sp = rest;
++			while (*sp &amp;&amp; *sp != ' ' &amp;&amp; *sp != '\t')
++				sp++;
++			int tl = (int)(sp - rest);
++			if (tl &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; tl &lt; (int)sizeof(tgt))
++				memcpy(tgt, rest, tl);
++			tgt[tl] = 0;
++			while (*sp == ' ' || *sp == '\t')
++				sp++;
++			if (*sp)
++				strncpy(disp, sp, sizeof(disp) - 1);
++			else
++				strncpy(disp, tgt, sizeof(disp) - 1);
++
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "=&gt; %s", disp);
++			strncpy(link_to, tgt, sizeof(link_to) - 1);
++			is_link = 1;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "# ", 2)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 2);
++			header_level = 1;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "## ", 3)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 3);
++			header_level = 2;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "### ", 4)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 4);
++			header_level = 3;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "&gt; ", 2)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line);
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "* ", 2)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "\xe2\x80\xa2 %s", line + 2);
++		} else {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line);
++		}
++
++		char resolved[512] = {0};
++		if (is_link)
++			resolve_url(current_url, link_to, resolved, sizeof(resolved));
++
++		if (header_level &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; cnt &gt; 0) {
++			new_items[cnt-1]-&gt;h += 5;  /* increase the top spacing a little before headings */
++		}
++
++		if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++			FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(ctx-&gt;ft_face, 0, ctx-&gt;font_size + 4 - header_level);
++		}
++		if (!in_pre) {
++			int nsubs = 0;
++			char **subs = wrap_text(ctx-&gt;ft_face, vis, max_text_w, &amp;nsubs);
++			for (int s = 0; s &lt; nsubs; s++) {
++				struct BGTK_Widget *tw = bgtk_text(ctx, subs[s], (BGTK_Options){.padding = 1, .margin = 1});
++				if (!tw) continue;
++				if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++					tw-&gt;data.text.header_level = header_level;
++				}
++				if (is_link &amp;&amp; num_page_links &lt; 128) {
++					link_target_widgets[num_page_links] = tw;
++					strncpy(link_targets[num_page_links], resolved, sizeof(link_targets[0]) - 1);
++					num_page_links++;
++					tw-&gt;handle_event = gemini_link_handler;
++				}
++				if (s &lt; nsubs - 1) {
++					tw-&gt;h -= 3;  /* decrease a little for lines in the same paragraph (tighter leading between wraps) */
++				}
++				if (s == nsubs - 1) {
++					tw-&gt;h += 5;  /* extra vertical space after this logical block */
++				}
++				if (cnt &gt;= cap) {
++					cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 32;
++					struct BGTK_Widget **ni = realloc(new_items, (size_t)cap * sizeof(*ni));
++					if (!ni) {
++						free(tw-&gt;data.text.text);
++						free(tw);
++						break;
++					}
++					new_items = ni;
++				}
++				new_items[cnt++] = tw;
++			}
++			for (int s = 0; s &lt; nsubs; s++) free(subs[s]);
++			free(subs);
++		} else {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *tw = bgtk_text(ctx, vis, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 1, .margin = 1});
++			if (tw) {
++				tw-&gt;h += 4;  /* space after pre block */
++				if (cnt &gt;= cap) {
++					cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 32;
++					struct BGTK_Widget **ni = realloc(new_items, (size_t)cap * sizeof(*ni));
++					if (!ni) {
++						free(tw-&gt;data.text.text);
++						free(tw);
++					} else {
++						new_items = ni;
++						new_items[cnt++] = tw;
++					}
++				} else {
++					new_items[cnt++] = tw;
++				}
++			}
++		}
++		if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++			FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(ctx-&gt;ft_face, 0, ctx-&gt;font_size);
++		}
++
++		line = strtok_r(NULL, "\n", &amp;save);
++	}
++	free(work);
++
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items = new_items;
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = cnt;
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
++}
++
++/* main navigation entry */
++static void load_url(const char *url)
++{
++	if (!url || !*url)
++		return;
++
++	strncpy(current_url, url, sizeof(current_url) - 1);
++	current_url[sizeof(current_url) - 1] = 0;
++
++	/* follow redirects a few times */
++	char tourl[512];
++	strncpy(tourl, url, sizeof(tourl) - 1);
++	int redirects = 0;
++	int status = 0;
++	char *meta = NULL;
++	char *body = NULL;
++	int feres = -1;
++
++	for (;;) {
++		if (meta) {
++			free(meta);
++			meta = NULL;
++		}
++		if (body) {
++			free(body);
++			body = NULL;
++		}
++		feres = fetch_gemini(tourl, &amp;status, &amp;meta, &amp;body);
++		if (feres == 0 &amp;&amp; (status == 30 || status == 31) &amp;&amp; meta &amp;&amp; *meta &amp;&amp; redirects &lt; 5) {
++			char next[512];
++			resolve_url(tourl, meta, next, sizeof(next));
++			strncpy(tourl, next, sizeof(tourl) - 1);
++			redirects++;
++			continue;
++		}
++		break;
++	}
++
++	/* update current to final */
++	strncpy(current_url, tourl, sizeof(current_url) - 1);
++
++	/* build UI lines */
++	if (feres != 0 || status / 10 != 2) {
++		char errline[256];
++		snprintf(errline, sizeof(errline), "Error %d %s", status, meta ? meta : "");
++		struct BGTK_Widget *et = bgtk_text(ctx, errline, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 1});
++		struct BGTK_Widget **errs = calloc(1, sizeof(*errs));
++		if (errs)
++			errs[0] = et;
++		/* free previous via rebuild but force single */
++		if (content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items) {
++			for (int i = 0; i &lt; content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++				struct BGTK_Widget *tw = content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
++				free(tw-&gt;data.text.text);
++				free(tw);
++			}
++			free(content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items);
++		}
++		content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items = errs;
++		content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = errs ? 1 : 0;
++		content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
++		num_page_links = 0;
++	} else {
++		rebuild_content_from_gemtext(body);
++	}
++
++	/* sync address bar (it serves as the URL display) */
++	free(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text = strdup(current_url);
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.cursor_pos = (uint32_t)strlen(current_url);
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.scroll_x = 0;
++
++	if (meta)
++		free(meta);
++	if (body)
++		free(body);
++
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++}
++
++static void go_button_cb(void)
++{
++	if (addr_input)
++		load_url(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++}
++
++static void addr_on_enter(void)
++{
++	if (addr_input)
++		load_url(addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++}
++
++int main(void)
++{
++	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
++	setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
++
++	SSL_load_error_strings();
++	OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms();
++
++	int conn_fd = bgce_connect();
++	if (conn_fd &lt; 0) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "gemini_browser: Failed to connect to BGCE server.\n");
++		return -1;
++	}
++
++	int width = 640;
++	int height = 480;
++	struct BufferRequest req = {.width = width, .height = height};
++	void *buffer = bgce_get_buffer(conn_fd, req);
++	if (!buffer) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "gemini_browser: Failed to get buffer from server.\n");
++		bgce_disconnect(conn_fd);
++		return -3;
++	}
++
++	ctx = bgtk_init(conn_fd, buffer, width, height);
++	if (!ctx) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "gemini_browser: Failed to initialize BGTK.\n");
++		return 1;
++	}
++
++	int usable_w = width - 20;
++
++	/* create button first to know its size, then size the input to make the row (address bar + button) full width */
++	struct BGTK_Widget *go_label = bgtk_text(ctx, "Go", (BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 0});
++	struct BGTK_Widget *go_btn = bgtk_button(ctx, go_label, go_button_cb,
++						 (BGTK_Options){.padding = 4, .margin = 2});
++	int input_w = usable_w - go_btn-&gt;w - 16;  /* leave room for row padding/margins */
++	addr_input = bgtk_text_input(ctx, "gemini://geminiprotocol.net/", input_w &gt; 100 ? input_w : 400, 0,
++				     (BGTK_Options){.padding = 4, .margin = 2});
++	addr_input-&gt;data.text_input.on_enter = addr_on_enter;
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *addr_items[2] = {addr_input, go_btn};
++	struct BGTK_Widget *addr_row = bgtk_list(ctx, addr_items, 2,
++						 (BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_HORIZONTAL, .padding = 2, .margin = 1});
++
++	/* content: scrollable holding the list of text items (gemtext lines) */
++	content_scroll = bgtk_scrollable(ctx, NULL, 0, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 3});
++
++	/* leave room inside the frame for addr_row + list spacing */
++	int v_margins = 16;
++	int reserved = (addr_row ? addr_row-&gt;h : 24) + v_margins;
++	int scroll_h = height - reserved - 24;
++	if (scroll_h &lt; 100)
++		scroll_h = 180;
++	content_scroll-&gt;w = usable_w;
++	content_scroll-&gt;h = scroll_h;
++
++	/* vertical list inside the frame: [content scroll of texts, address bar at bottom] */
++	struct BGTK_Widget *main_items[2] = {content_scroll, addr_row};
++	struct BGTK_Widget *main_list = bgtk_list(ctx, main_items, 2,
++						  (BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_VERTICAL, .padding = 2, .margin = 2});
++
++	/* single frame around everything (content + address bar at bottom) */
++	struct BGTK_Widget *frame = bgtk_frame(ctx, main_list, width, height,
++					       (BGTK_Options){.padding = 4, .margin = 0});
++
++	ctx-&gt;root_widget = frame;
++	bgtk_set_focus(ctx, addr_input);
++
++	/* initial page */
++	load_url(current_url);
++
++	printf("gemini_browser starting (%dx%d) on %s\n", width, height, current_url);
++
++	struct BGCEMessage msg;
++	ssize_t bytes;
++	while (1) {
++		bytes = bgce_recv_msg(ctx-&gt;conn_fd, &amp;msg);
++		if (bytes &lt;= 0) {
++			if (bytes == 0)
++				fprintf(stderr, "gemini_browser: Server closed connection.\n");
++			else if (errno != EINTR)
++				perror("gemini_browser: bgce_recv_msg");
++			break;
++		}
++
++		int res = 0;
++		switch (msg.type) {

++		case MSG_FOCUS_CHANGE:

++			break;
++		default:
++			break;
++		}
++		if (res)
++			bgce_draw(conn_fd);
++	}
++
++	bgtk_destroy(ctx);
++	return 0;
++}

++/* test/test_gemini_browser.c
++ *
++ * Headless (mock) test version of the gemini browser.
++ * Lets you run on macOS or anywhere without bgce server or network.
++ * Builds the real widget tree (frame + vertical list + scrollable of text lines
++ * for gemtext + current URL text + address bar at bottom inside the frame).
++ *
++ * Exercises layout, text rendering, text input focus/typing/enter, link clicking
++ * (via custom handle_event on some lines), content replacement on "nav", and
++ * produces PNG screenshots you can visually inspect.
++ *
++ * Build: make test_gemini_browser
++ * Run:   ./test_gemini_browser
++ * Output: gemini_browser_*.png files
++ */
++
++#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
++#include &lt;string.h&gt;
++#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
++#include &lt;sys/socket.h&gt;
++#include &lt;netdb.h&gt;
++#include &lt;arpa/inet.h&gt;
++#include &lt;linux/input.h&gt;
++#include &lt;ctype.h&gt;
++
++#include &lt;openssl/ssl.h&gt;
++#include &lt;openssl/err.h&gt;
++
++#include "bgtk.h"
++
++static struct BGTK_Context *ctx = NULL;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *content_scroll = NULL;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *addr_input = NULL;
++
++static char current_url[512] = "gemini://geminiprotocol.net/";
++static struct BGTK_Widget *link_target_widgets[128];
++static char link_targets[128][512];
++static int num_page_links = 0;

++/* --- Real Gemini client (copied/adapted from the main app for the test) --- */
++
++static int fetch_gemini(const char *req_url, int *out_status, char **out_meta, char **out_body)
++{
++	*out_status = 0;
++	*out_meta = NULL;
++	*out_body = NULL;
++
++	char host[256] = {0};
++	char path[768] = "/";
++	int port = 1965;
++
++	const char *p = req_url;
++	if (!strncmp(p, "gemini://", 9))
++		p += 9;
++	const char *he = strchr(p, '/');
++	const char *pe = strchr(p, ':');
++	if (pe &amp;&amp; (!he || pe &lt; he)) {
++		int hl = (int)(pe - p);
++		if (hl &gt; 255) hl = 255;
++		memcpy(host, p, hl); host[hl] = 0;
++		port = atoi(pe + 1);
++		if (he) strncpy(path, he, sizeof(path)-1);
++	} else if (he) {
++		int hl = (int)(he - p);
++		memcpy(host, p, hl); host[hl] = 0;
++		strncpy(path, he, sizeof(path)-1);
++	} else {
++		strncpy(host, p, sizeof(host)-1);
++	}
++	if (!host[0]) return -1;
++	if (port &lt; 1) port = 1965;
++	if (!path[0]) strcpy(path, "/");
++
++	char selector[1024];
++	strncpy(selector, req_url, sizeof(selector)-1);
++
++	SSL_CTX *sctx = SSL_CTX_new(TLS_client_method());
++	if (!sctx) return -2;
++	SSL_CTX_set_verify(sctx, SSL_VERIFY_NONE, NULL);
++
++	int sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
++	if (sock &lt; 0) { SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -3; }
++
++	struct hostent *heent = gethostbyname(host);
++	if (!heent) { close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -4; }
++	struct sockaddr_in sin = {0};
++	sin.sin_family = AF_INET;
++	sin.sin_port = htons(port);
++	memcpy(&amp;sin.sin_addr, heent-&gt;h_addr_list[0], heent-&gt;h_length);
++
++	if (connect(sock, (struct sockaddr *)&amp;sin, sizeof(sin)) &lt; 0) {
++		close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -5;
++	}
++
++	SSL *ssl = SSL_new(sctx);
++	SSL_set_fd(ssl, sock);
++	if (SSL_connect(ssl) != 1) {
++		SSL_free(ssl); close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -6;
++	}
++
++	char req[1200];
++	int rlen = snprintf(req, sizeof(req), "%s\r\n", selector);
++	if (SSL_write(ssl, req, rlen) &lt;= 0) {
++		SSL_free(ssl); close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -7;
++	}
++
++	/* read header */
++	char hbuf[1024] = {0};
++	int hlen = 0;
++	while (hlen &lt; (int)sizeof(hbuf)-1) {
++		int n = SSL_read(ssl, hbuf + hlen, 1);
++		if (n &lt;= 0) break;
++		hlen += n;
++		if (hlen &gt;= 2 &amp;&amp; hbuf[hlen-2]=='\r' &amp;&amp; hbuf[hlen-1]=='\n') break;
++	}
++	hbuf[hlen] = 0;
++
++	int status = 0;
++	char meta[512] = {0};
++	if (sscanf(hbuf, "%d %511[^\r\n]", &amp;status, meta) &lt; 1) status = 59;
++	*out_status = status;
++	if (out_meta) *out_meta = strdup(meta);
++
++	/* read body */
++	size_t cap = 8192;
++	size_t blen = 0;
++	char *body = malloc(cap);
++	if (!body) { SSL_free(ssl); close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -8; }
++	for (;;) {
++		char rbuf[1024];
++		int n = SSL_read(ssl, rbuf, sizeof(rbuf));
++		if (n &lt;= 0) break;
++		if (blen + (size_t)n + 1 &gt; cap) {
++			cap = cap * 2 + n;
++			char *nb = realloc(body, cap);
++			if (!nb) { free(body); SSL_free(ssl); close(sock); SSL_CTX_free(sctx); return -8; }
++			body = nb;
++		}
++		memcpy(body + blen, rbuf, n);
++		blen += n;
++	}
++	body[blen] = 0;
++	*out_body = body;
++
++	SSL_shutdown(ssl);
++	SSL_free(ssl);
++	close(sock);
++	SSL_CTX_free(sctx);
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static void resolve_url(const char *base, const char *rel, char *out, size_t outlen)
++{
++	if (!rel || !*rel) {
++		strncpy(out, base, outlen-1); out[outlen-1]=0; return;
++	}
++	if (strstr(rel, "://") || !strncmp(rel, "gemini:", 7)) {
++		strncpy(out, rel, outlen-1); out[outlen-1]=0; return;
++	}
++
++	char bhost[256] = {0};
++	char bpath[512] = {0};
++	int bport = 1965;
++
++	const char *p = base;
++	if (!strncmp(p, "gemini://", 9)) p += 9;
++	const char *he = strchr(p, '/');
++	const char *pe = strchr(p, ':');
++	if (pe &amp;&amp; (!he || pe &lt; he)) {
++		int hl = (int)(pe - p); if (hl &gt; 255) hl=255;
++		memcpy(bhost, p, hl); bhost[hl]=0;
++		bport = atoi(pe+1);
++		if (he) strncpy(bpath, he, sizeof(bpath)-1); else strcpy(bpath, "/");
++	} else if (he) {
++		int hl = (int)(he - p);
++		memcpy(bhost, p, hl); bhost[hl]=0;
++		strncpy(bpath, he, sizeof(bpath)-1);
++	} else {
++		strncpy(bhost, p, sizeof(bhost)-1);
++		strcpy(bpath, "/");
++	}
++	if (!bpath[0]) strcpy(bpath, "/");
++
++	char portpart[32] = "";
++	if (bport != 1965) snprintf(portpart, sizeof(portpart), ":%d", bport);
++
++	if (rel[0] == '/') {
++		snprintf(out, outlen, "gemini://%s%s%s", bhost, portpart, rel);
++		return;
++	}
++
++	char dir[512];
++	strncpy(dir, bpath, sizeof(dir)-1);
++	char *ls = strrchr(dir, '/');
++	if (ls) *(ls+1) = 0; else strcpy(dir, "/");
++
++	char full[1024];
++	snprintf(full, sizeof(full), "%s%s", dir, rel);
++
++	char *segs[64]; int nseg = 0;
++	char *tmp = strdup(full);
++	char *save = NULL;
++	char *seg = strtok_r(tmp, "/", &amp;save);
++	while (seg) {
++		if (!strcmp(seg, ".") || !*seg) {
++		} else if (!strcmp(seg, "..")) {
++			if (nseg &gt; 0) nseg--;
++		} else {
++			segs[nseg++] = seg;
++		}
++		seg = strtok_r(NULL, "/", &amp;save);
++	}
++
++	char norm[1024] = "/";
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; nseg; i++) {
++		strcat(norm, segs[i]);
++		if (i+1 &lt; nseg) strcat(norm, "/");
++	}
++	free(tmp);
++
++	snprintf(out, outlen, "gemini://%s%s%s", bhost, portpart, norm);
++}
++
++/* Simple word-wrap for long paragraphs and link labels. Returns malloc'ed array of lines (caller frees). */
++static char **wrap_text(FT_Face face, const char *text, int max_width, int *nlines)
++{
++	*nlines = 0;
++	if (!face || !text || !*text || max_width &lt; 20) return NULL;
++	char **lines = NULL;
++	int n = 0, cap = 0;
++	int len = strlen(text);
++	int i = 0;
++	while (i &lt; len) {
++		int j = i;
++		int last_space = -1;
++		int w = 0;
++		for (; j &lt; len; j++) {
++			unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)text[j];
++			if (FT_Load_Char(face, ch, FT_LOAD_DEFAULT) == 0)
++				w += face-&gt;glyph-&gt;advance.x &gt;&gt; 6;
++			if (w &gt; max_width &amp;&amp; j &gt; i) break;
++			if (isspace(ch)) last_space = j;
++		}
++		int end = (j &gt;= len) ? len : (last_space &gt; i ? last_space : j);
++		int lnlen = end - i;
++		char *ln = malloc(lnlen + 1);
++		memcpy(ln, text + i, lnlen);
++		ln[lnlen] = 0;
++		while (lnlen &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)ln[lnlen-1])) ln[--lnlen] = 0;
++		if (n &gt;= cap) {
++			cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 8;
++			lines = realloc(lines, cap * sizeof(char *));
++		}
++		lines[n++] = ln;
++		i = end;
++		while (i &lt; len &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)text[i])) i++;
++	}
++	*nlines = n;
++	return lines;
++}

++/* Rebuild scrollable content from real gemtext body (same logic as the main app) */
++static int gemini_link_handler(struct BGTK_Widget *w, struct InputEvent ev);
++
++static void rebuild_content_from_gemtext(const char *body)
++{
++	if (content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *tw = content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i];
++			if (tw) {
++				free(tw-&gt;data.text.text);
++				free(tw);
++			}
++		}
++		free(content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items);
++	}
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items = NULL;
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = 0;
++	num_page_links = 0;
++
++	if (!body) return;
++
++	int max_text_w = 480;
++	if (content_scroll &amp;&amp; content_scroll-&gt;w &gt; 100)
++		max_text_w = content_scroll-&gt;w - 8;
++
++	char *work = strdup(body);
++	if (!work) return;
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget **new_items = NULL;
++	int cap = 0, cnt = 0;
++
++	char *save = NULL;
++	char *line = strtok_r(work, "\n", &amp;save);
++	int in_pre = 0;
++	while (line) {
++		char *cr = strchr(line, '\r');
++		if (cr) *cr = 0;
++
++		if (!strncmp(line, "```", 3)) {
++			in_pre = !in_pre;
++			line = strtok_r(NULL, "\n", &amp;save);
++			continue;
++		}
++
++		char vis[768];
++		int is_link = 0;
++		char link_to[512] = {0};
++		int header_level = 0;
++
++		if (in_pre) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "  %s", line);
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "=&gt;", 2)) {
++			char tgt[512] = {0};
++			char disp[512] = {0};
++			const char *rest = line + 2;
++			while (*rest == ' ' || *rest == '\t') rest++;
++			const char *sp = rest;
++			while (*sp &amp;&amp; *sp != ' ' &amp;&amp; *sp != '\t') sp++;
++			int tl = (int)(sp - rest);
++			if (tl &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; tl &lt; (int)sizeof(tgt)) memcpy(tgt, rest, tl);
++			tgt[tl] = 0;
++			while (*sp == ' ' || *sp == '\t') sp++;
++			if (*sp) strncpy(disp, sp, sizeof(disp)-1);
++			else strncpy(disp, tgt, sizeof(disp)-1);
++
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "=&gt; %s", disp);
++			strncpy(link_to, tgt, sizeof(link_to)-1);
++			is_link = 1;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "# ", 2)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 2);
++			header_level = 1;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "## ", 3)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 3);
++			header_level = 2;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "### ", 4)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line + 4);
++			header_level = 3;
++		} else if (!strncmp(line, "&gt; ", 2) || !strncmp(line, "* ", 2)) {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line[0]=='*' ? "\xe2\x80\xa2 " : "");
++			if (line[0]=='*') strncat(vis, line+2, sizeof(vis)-strlen(vis)-1);
++			else strncat(vis, line, sizeof(vis)-strlen(vis)-1);
++		} else {
++			snprintf(vis, sizeof(vis), "%s", line);
++		}
++
++		char resolved[512] = {0};
++		if (is_link)
++			resolve_url(current_url, link_to, resolved, sizeof(resolved));
++
++		if (header_level &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; cnt &gt; 0) {
++			new_items[cnt-1]-&gt;h += 5;  /* increase the top spacing a little before headings */
++		}
++
++		if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++			FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(ctx-&gt;ft_face, 0, ctx-&gt;font_size + 4 - header_level);
++		}
++		if (!in_pre) {
++			int nsubs = 0;
++			char **subs = wrap_text(ctx-&gt;ft_face, vis, max_text_w, &amp;nsubs);
++			for (int s = 0; s &lt; nsubs; s++) {
++				struct BGTK_Widget *tw = bgtk_text(ctx, subs[s], (BGTK_Options){.padding=1, .margin=1});
++				if (!tw) continue;
++				if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++					tw-&gt;data.text.header_level = header_level;
++				}
++				if (is_link &amp;&amp; num_page_links &lt; 128) {
++					link_target_widgets[num_page_links] = tw;
++					strncpy(link_targets[num_page_links], resolved, sizeof(link_targets[0])-1);
++					num_page_links++;
++					tw-&gt;handle_event = gemini_link_handler;
++				}
++				if (s &lt; nsubs - 1) {
++					tw-&gt;h -= 3;  /* decrease a little for lines in the same paragraph (tighter leading between wraps) */
++				}
++				if (s == nsubs - 1) {
++					tw-&gt;h += 5;  /* extra vertical space after this logical block */
++				}
++				if (cnt &gt;= cap) {
++					cap = cap ? cap*2 : 32;
++					struct BGTK_Widget **ni = realloc(new_items, (size_t)cap * sizeof(*ni));
++					if (!ni) { free(tw-&gt;data.text.text); free(tw); break; }
++					new_items = ni;
++				}
++				new_items[cnt++] = tw;
++			}
++			for (int s = 0; s &lt; nsubs; s++) free(subs[s]);
++			free(subs);
++		} else {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *tw = bgtk_text(ctx, vis, (BGTK_Options){.padding=1, .margin=1});
++			if (tw) {
++				tw-&gt;h += 4;  /* space after pre block */
++				if (cnt &gt;= cap) {
++					cap = cap ? cap*2 : 32;
++					struct BGTK_Widget **ni = realloc(new_items, (size_t)cap * sizeof(*ni));
++					if (!ni) { free(tw-&gt;data.text.text); free(tw); }
++					else { new_items = ni; new_items[cnt++] = tw; }
++				} else {
++					new_items[cnt++] = tw;
++				}
++			}
++		}
++		if (header_level &gt; 0) {
++			FT_Set_Pixel_Sizes(ctx-&gt;ft_face, 0, ctx-&gt;font_size);
++		}
++
++		line = strtok_r(NULL, "\n", &amp;save);
++	}
++	free(work);
++
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items = new_items;
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = cnt;
++	content_scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.scroll_y = 0;
++}

++/* Real navigation using live capsule */
++static void load_real_url(const char *url);
++
++static int gemini_link_handler(struct BGTK_Widget *w, struct InputEvent ev)
++{
++	if (ev.code == BTN_LEFT &amp;&amp; ev.value == 1) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; num_page_links; i++) {
++			if (link_target_widgets[i] == w) {
++				load_real_url(link_targets[i]);
++				return 1;
++			}
++		}
++	}
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static void load_real_url(const char *url)
++{
++	if (!url || !*url) return;
++
++	strncpy(current_url, url, sizeof(current_url)-1);
++	current_url[sizeof(current_url)-1] = 0;
++
++	char tourl[512];
++	strncpy(tourl, url, sizeof(tourl)-1);
++	int redirects = 0;
++	int status = 0;
++	char *meta = NULL;
++	char *body = NULL;
++	int feres = -1;
++
++	for (;;) {
++		if (meta) { free(meta); meta = NULL; }
++		if (body) { free(body); body = NULL; }
++		feres = fetch_gemini(tourl, &amp;status, &amp;meta, &amp;body);
++		if (feres == 0 &amp;&amp; (status == 30 || status == 31) &amp;&amp; meta &amp;&amp; *meta &amp;&amp; redirects &lt; 5) {

+commit e8ee141
+parent <a href=commit-0182d04.html>0182d04</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-14T21:00:10-03:00
+
+    feat: CSS v1, horizontal scroll, fewer launcher/text draws
+
+    Add css.c for basic stylesheets/inline styles in HTML parsing.
+    Labyrinth Shift+wheel and scroll_x pan wide content. Launcher and
+    text_input stop double-presenting so each action draws once.
+    Refresh www/bgtk.tar.gz.
+

+ 			uint32_t* tmp;	     // off-screen buffer

+ 			 * are swapped (settings sidebar) without freeing tmp,
+diff --git a/compat/linux/input.h b/compat/linux/input.h

++/* css.c — minimal CSS parser/applier for BGTK HTML */
++#include "css.h"
++#include "config.h"
++
++#include &lt;ctype.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
++#include &lt;string.h&gt;
++#include &lt;strings.h&gt;
++
++enum {
++	SEL_UNIVERSAL = 0,
++	SEL_TYPE = 1,
++	SEL_CLASS = 10,
++	SEL_ID = 100,
++};
++
++struct BGTK_CSS_Decl {
++	int color_set, bg_set;
++	uint32_t color, bg;
++	int font_weight; /* 0 unset, 1 normal, 2 bold */
++	int font_style;  /* 0 unset, 1 normal, 2 italic */
++	int text_align;  /* -1 unset, 0 left, 1 center, 2 right */
++	int margin;      /* -1 unset */
++	int padding;     /* -1 unset */
++	int display_none;
++};
++
++struct BGTK_CSS_Rule {
++	char sel_type[32];  /* empty = any */
++	char sel_class[64]; /* empty = any */
++	char sel_id[64];    /* empty = any */
++	int specificity;
++	struct BGTK_CSS_Decl decl;
++};

++struct BGTK_CSS {
++	struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *rules;

++struct BGTK_CSS *bgtk_css_create(void)
++{
++	return calloc(1, sizeof(struct BGTK_CSS));
++}
++
++void bgtk_css_destroy(struct BGTK_CSS *css)
++{
++	if (!css)
++		return;
++	free(css-&gt;rules);

++static void skip_ws(const char **pp)
++{
++	const char *p = *pp;
++	while (*p &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)*p))
++		p++;
++	*pp = p;
++}
++
++uint32_t bgtk_css_parse_color(const char *s)
++{
++	static const struct {
++		const char *name;
++		uint32_t c;
++	} named[] = {
++		{ "black", 0xFF000000 },   { "white", 0xFFFFFFFF },
++		{ "red", 0xFFFF0000 },	   { "green", 0xFF008000 },
++		{ "blue", 0xFF0000FF },	   { "yellow", 0xFFFFFF00 },
++		{ "cyan", 0xFF00FFFF },	   { "magenta", 0xFFFF00FF },
++		{ "gray", 0xFF808080 },	   { "grey", 0xFF808080 },
++		{ "orange", 0xFFFFA500 },  { "purple", 0xFF800080 },
++		{ "navy", 0xFF000080 },	   { "teal", 0xFF008080 },
++		{ "silver", 0xFFC0C0C0 },  { "maroon", 0xFF800000 },
++		{ "lime", 0xFF00FF00 },	   { "aqua", 0xFF00FFFF },
++		{ "fuchsia", 0xFFFF00FF }, { "olive", 0xFF808000 },
++		{ "transparent", 0 },
++	};
++	char buf[64];
++	size_t i, n;
++
++	if (!s || !*s)
++		return 0;
++	skip_ws(&amp;s);
++	if (*s == '#') {
++		uint32_t c = parse_hex_color(s);
++		/* parse_hex_color returns opaque black on bad input; accept #000 */
++		if (s[0] == '#' &amp;&amp; (strlen(s) == 4 || strlen(s) == 7 ||
++				    strlen(s) == 9)) {
++			if (strlen(s) == 4) {
++				/* #rgb → #rrggbb */
++				unsigned r, g, b;
++				if (sscanf(s + 1, "%1x%1x%1x", &amp;r, &amp;g, &amp;b) ==
++				    3) {
++					r |= r &lt;&lt; 4;
++					g |= g &lt;&lt; 4;
++					b |= b &lt;&lt; 4;
++					return 0xFF000000u | (r &lt;&lt; 16) |
++					       (g &lt;&lt; 8) | b;
++				}
++			}
++			return c;
++		}
++		return 0;
++	}
++	n = 0;
++	while (s[n] &amp;&amp; (isalnum((unsigned char)s[n]) || s[n] == '-') &amp;&amp;
++	       n + 1 &lt; sizeof(buf)) {
++		buf[n] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)s[n]);
++		n++;
++	}
++	buf[n] = '\0';
++	for (i = 0; i &lt; sizeof(named) / sizeof(named[0]); i++) {
++		if (strcmp(buf, named[i].name) == 0)
++			return named[i].c;
++	}
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static int parse_px(const char *v)
++{
++	char *end;
++	long n;
++
++	if (!v)
++		return -1;
++	skip_ws(&amp;v);
++	n = strtol(v, &amp;end, 10);
++	if (end == v)
++		return -1;
++	while (*end &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)*end))
++		end++;
++	if (*end == 'p' || *end == 'P')
++		end++;
++	if (*end == 'x' || *end == 'X')
++		end++;
++	(void)end;
++	if (n &lt; 0)
++		n = 0;
++	if (n &gt; 10000)
++		n = 10000;
++	return (int)n;
++}
++
++static void decl_clear(struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *d)
++{
++	memset(d, 0, sizeof(*d));
++	d-&gt;text_align = -1;
++	d-&gt;margin = -1;
++	d-&gt;padding = -1;
++}
++
++static void decl_set_prop(struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *d, const char *prop,
++			  const char *val)
++{
++	char p[64], v[128];
++	size_t i;
++
++	if (!d || !prop || !val)
++		return;
++	for (i = 0; prop[i] &amp;&amp; i + 1 &lt; sizeof(p); i++)
++		p[i] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)prop[i]);
++	p[i] = '\0';
++	/* trim val */
++	while (*val &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)*val))
++		val++;
++	{
++		size_t len = strlen(val);
++		while (len &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)val[len - 1]))
++			len--;
++		if (len &gt;= sizeof(v))
++			len = sizeof(v) - 1;
++		memcpy(v, val, len);
++		v[len] = '\0';
++	}
++
++	if (strcmp(p, "color") == 0) {
++		uint32_t c = bgtk_css_parse_color(v);
++		if (c || strcasecmp(v, "transparent") == 0 ||
++		    strcasecmp(v, "black") == 0) {
++			d-&gt;color = c ? c : 0xFF000000u;
++			if (strcasecmp(v, "transparent") == 0)
++				d-&gt;color = 0;
++			d-&gt;color_set = 1;
++		}
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "background-color") == 0 ||
++		   strcmp(p, "background") == 0) {
++		/* background: #hex [ignore rest] */
++		char tok[64];
++		const char *q = v;
++		size_t n = 0;
++		while (*q &amp;&amp; !isspace((unsigned char)*q) &amp;&amp; n + 1 &lt; sizeof(tok))
++			tok[n++] = *q++;
++		tok[n] = '\0';
++		{
++			uint32_t c = bgtk_css_parse_color(tok);
++			if (c || strcasecmp(tok, "transparent") == 0 ||
++			    strcasecmp(tok, "black") == 0) {
++				d-&gt;bg = c;
++				if (strcasecmp(tok, "black") == 0 &amp;&amp; !c)
++					d-&gt;bg = 0xFF000000u;
++				d-&gt;bg_set = 1;
++			}
++		}
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "font-weight") == 0) {
++		if (strcasecmp(v, "bold") == 0 || strcmp(v, "700") == 0 ||
++		    strcmp(v, "800") == 0 || strcmp(v, "900") == 0)
++			d-&gt;font_weight = 2;
++		else if (strcasecmp(v, "normal") == 0 || strcmp(v, "400") == 0)
++			d-&gt;font_weight = 1;
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "font-style") == 0) {
++		if (strcasecmp(v, "italic") == 0 ||
++		    strcasecmp(v, "oblique") == 0)
++			d-&gt;font_style = 2;
++		else if (strcasecmp(v, "normal") == 0)
++			d-&gt;font_style = 1;
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "text-align") == 0) {
++		if (strcasecmp(v, "left") == 0)
++			d-&gt;text_align = 0;
++		else if (strcasecmp(v, "center") == 0)
++			d-&gt;text_align = 1;
++		else if (strcasecmp(v, "right") == 0)
++			d-&gt;text_align = 2;
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "margin") == 0) {
++		int px = parse_px(v);
++		if (px &gt;= 0)
++			d-&gt;margin = px;
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "padding") == 0) {
++		int px = parse_px(v);
++		if (px &gt;= 0)
++			d-&gt;padding = px;
++	} else if (strcmp(p, "display") == 0) {
++		if (strcasecmp(v, "none") == 0)
++			d-&gt;display_none = 1;
++	}
++}
++
++static void parse_declarations(const char *block, struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *d)
++{
++	const char *p = block;
++
++	decl_clear(d);
++	while (*p) {
++		char prop[64], val[128];
++		size_t n;
++		const char *colon, *semi, *end;
++
++		skip_ws(&amp;p);
++		if (!*p || *p == '}')
++			break;
++		colon = strchr(p, ':');
++		if (!colon)
++			break;
++		n = 0;
++		while (p &lt; colon &amp;&amp; n + 1 &lt; sizeof(prop)) {
++			if (!isspace((unsigned char)*p))
++				prop[n++] = *p;
++			p++;
++		}
++		prop[n] = '\0';
++		p = colon + 1;
++		skip_ws(&amp;p);
++		semi = strchr(p, ';');
++		end = semi ? semi : p + strlen(p);
++		n = 0;
++		while (p &lt; end &amp;&amp; n + 1 &lt; sizeof(val))
++			val[n++] = *p++;
++		val[n] = '\0';
++		/* trim trailing space */
++		while (n &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)val[n - 1]))
++			val[--n] = '\0';
++		decl_set_prop(d, prop, val);
++		if (semi)
++			p = semi + 1;
++		else
++			break;
++	}
++}
++
++static int parse_selector(const char *sel, struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *r)
++{
++	const char *p = sel;
++	size_t n;
++
++	r-&gt;sel_type[0] = r-&gt;sel_class[0] = r-&gt;sel_id[0] = '\0';
++	r-&gt;specificity = 0;
++	skip_ws(&amp;p);
++	if (!*p)
++		return -1;
++	if (*p == '*') {
++		r-&gt;specificity = SEL_UNIVERSAL;
++		return 0;
++	}
++	/* type */
++	if (isalpha((unsigned char)*p)) {
++		n = 0;
++		while (*p &amp;&amp; (isalnum((unsigned char)*p) || *p == '-') &amp;&amp;
++		       n + 1 &lt; sizeof(r-&gt;sel_type))
++			r-&gt;sel_type[n++] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*p++);
++		r-&gt;sel_type[n] = '\0';
++		r-&gt;specificity += SEL_TYPE;
++	}
++	while (*p == '.' || *p == '#') {
++		int is_id = (*p == '#');
++		char *dst = is_id ? r-&gt;sel_id : r-&gt;sel_class;
++		size_t max = is_id ? sizeof(r-&gt;sel_id) : sizeof(r-&gt;sel_class);
++
++		p++;
++		n = 0;
++		while (*p &amp;&amp; (isalnum((unsigned char)*p) || *p == '-' ||
++			      *p == '_') &amp;&amp;
++		       n + 1 &lt; max)
++			dst[n++] = *p++;
++		dst[n] = '\0';
++		r-&gt;specificity += is_id ? SEL_ID : SEL_CLASS;
++	}
++	skip_ws(&amp;p);
++	/* reject complex selectors for v1 */
++	if (*p)
++		return -1;
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static void css_add_rule(struct BGTK_CSS *css, const struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *r)
++{
++	if (!css)
++		return;
++	if (css-&gt;n &gt;= css-&gt;cap) {
++		int ncap = css-&gt;cap ? css-&gt;cap * 2 : 16;
++		struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *nr =
++			realloc(css-&gt;rules, (size_t)ncap * sizeof(*nr));
++		if (!nr)
++			return;
++		css-&gt;rules = nr;
++		css-&gt;cap = ncap;
++	}
++	css-&gt;rules[css-&gt;n++] = *r;
++}
++
++void bgtk_css_add_sheet(struct BGTK_CSS *css, const char *source)
++{
++	const char *p;
++
++	if (!css || !source)
++		return;
++	p = source;
++	while (*p) {
++		char selbuf[128], declbuf[512];
++		const char *brace, *end;
++		size_t n;
++		struct BGTK_CSS_Rule rule;
++
++		skip_ws(&amp;p);
++		if (!*p)
++			break;
++		/* skip comments */
++		if (p[0] == '/' &amp;&amp; p[1] == '*') {
++			p += 2;
++			while (*p &amp;&amp; !(p[0] == '*' &amp;&amp; p[1] == '/'))
++				p++;
++			if (*p)
++				p += 2;
++			continue;
++		}
++		/* @-rules: skip until next {…} or ; */
++		if (*p == '@') {
++			brace = strchr(p, '{');
++			if (brace) {
++				int depth = 1;
++				p = brace + 1;
++				while (*p &amp;&amp; depth) {
++					if (*p == '{')
++						depth++;
++					else if (*p == '}')
++						depth--;
++					p++;
++				}
++			} else {
++				while (*p &amp;&amp; *p != ';')
++					p++;
++				if (*p == ';')
++					p++;
++			}
++			continue;
++		}
++		brace = strchr(p, '{');
++		if (!brace)
++			break;
++		n = (size_t)(brace - p);
++		while (n &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)p[n - 1]))
++			n--;
++		if (n &gt;= sizeof(selbuf))
++			n = sizeof(selbuf) - 1;
++		memcpy(selbuf, p, n);
++		selbuf[n] = '\0';
++		p = brace + 1;
++		end = strchr(p, '}');
++		if (!end)
++			break;
++		n = (size_t)(end - p);
++		if (n &gt;= sizeof(declbuf))
++			n = sizeof(declbuf) - 1;
++		memcpy(declbuf, p, n);
++		declbuf[n] = '\0';
++		p = end + 1;
++
++		/* split selectors on comma */
++		{
++			char *save = NULL;
++			char *tok = strtok_r(selbuf, ",", &amp;save);
++			while (tok) {
++				memset(&amp;rule, 0, sizeof(rule));
++				decl_clear(&amp;rule.decl);
++				if (parse_selector(tok, &amp;rule) == 0) {
++					parse_declarations(declbuf, &amp;rule.decl);
++					css_add_rule(css, &amp;rule);
++				}
++				tok = strtok_r(NULL, ",", &amp;save);
++			}
++		}
++	}
++}
++
++static int class_list_has(const char *class_attr, const char *want)
++{
++	const char *p;
++	size_t wlen;
++
++	if (!class_attr || !want || !*want)
++		return 0;
++	wlen = strlen(want);
++	p = class_attr;
++	while (*p) {
++		while (*p &amp;&amp; isspace((unsigned char)*p))
++			p++;
++		if (!strncmp(p, want, wlen) &amp;&amp;
++		    (p[wlen] == '\0' || isspace((unsigned char)p[wlen])))
++			return 1;
++		while (*p &amp;&amp; !isspace((unsigned char)*p))
++			p++;
++	}
++	return 0;
++}
++
++static int rule_matches(const struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *r, const char *tag,
++			const char *id, const char *class_attr)
++{
++	if (r-&gt;sel_type[0] &amp;&amp;
++	    (!tag || strcasecmp(r-&gt;sel_type, tag) != 0))
++		return 0;
++	if (r-&gt;sel_id[0] &amp;&amp; (!id || strcmp(r-&gt;sel_id, id) != 0))
++		return 0;
++	if (r-&gt;sel_class[0] &amp;&amp; !class_list_has(class_attr, r-&gt;sel_class))
++		return 0;
++	/* universal / empty selector matches everything */
++	if (!r-&gt;sel_type[0] &amp;&amp; !r-&gt;sel_id[0] &amp;&amp; !r-&gt;sel_class[0] &amp;&amp;
++	    r-&gt;specificity == 0)
++		return 1;
++	return 1;
++}
++
++static void decl_merge(struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *dst, const struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *src)
++{
++	if (src-&gt;color_set) {
++		dst-&gt;color = src-&gt;color;
++		dst-&gt;color_set = 1;
++	}
++	if (src-&gt;bg_set) {
++		dst-&gt;bg = src-&gt;bg;
++		dst-&gt;bg_set = 1;
++	}
++	if (src-&gt;font_weight)
++		dst-&gt;font_weight = src-&gt;font_weight;
++	if (src-&gt;font_style)
++		dst-&gt;font_style = src-&gt;font_style;
++	if (src-&gt;text_align &gt;= 0)
++		dst-&gt;text_align = src-&gt;text_align;
++	if (src-&gt;margin &gt;= 0)
++		dst-&gt;margin = src-&gt;margin;
++	if (src-&gt;padding &gt;= 0)
++		dst-&gt;padding = src-&gt;padding;
++	if (src-&gt;display_none)
++		dst-&gt;display_none = 1;
++}
++
++static void apply_decl_to_widget(struct BGTK_Widget *w,
++				 const struct BGTK_CSS_Decl *d)
++{
++	if (!w || !d)
++		return;
++	if (d-&gt;color_set)
++		w-&gt;color_fg = d-&gt;color ? d-&gt;color : 0xFF000000u;
++	if (d-&gt;bg_set)
++		w-&gt;color_bg = d-&gt;bg;
++	if (d-&gt;margin &gt;= 0)
++		w-&gt;margin = d-&gt;margin;
++	if (d-&gt;padding &gt;= 0)
++		w-&gt;padding = d-&gt;padding;
++	if (d-&gt;text_align == 0)
++		w-&gt;text_align = BGTK_ALIGN_LEFT;
++	else if (d-&gt;text_align == 1)
++		w-&gt;text_align = BGTK_ALIGN_CENTER;
++	else if (d-&gt;text_align == 2)
++		w-&gt;text_align = BGTK_ALIGN_RIGHT;
++	if (w-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT) {
++		if (d-&gt;font_weight == 2)
++			w-&gt;data.text.style |= BGTK_TEXT_BOLD;
++		else if (d-&gt;font_weight == 1)
++			w-&gt;data.text.style &amp;= ~BGTK_TEXT_BOLD;
++		if (d-&gt;font_style == 2)
++			w-&gt;data.text.style |= BGTK_TEXT_ITALIC;
++		else if (d-&gt;font_style == 1)
++			w-&gt;data.text.style &amp;= ~BGTK_TEXT_ITALIC;
++	}
++	if (w-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_BUTTON &amp;&amp; d-&gt;bg_set &amp;&amp; d-&gt;bg)
++		w-&gt;data.button.bg_override = d-&gt;bg;
++}
++
++int bgtk_css_apply(struct BGTK_CSS *css, struct BGTK_Widget *w, const char *tag,
++		   const char *id, const char *class_attr,
++		   const char *style_attr)
++{
++	struct BGTK_CSS_Decl acc;
++	int i, changed;
++
++	decl_clear(&amp;acc);
++	if (css &amp;&amp; css-&gt;n &gt; 0) {
++		/* Sort by specificity (stable for equals → later source wins
++		 * if we use a stable bubble that only swaps on &lt; ). */
++		int *idx = malloc((size_t)css-&gt;n * sizeof(int));
++		int a, b;
++
++		if (idx) {
++			for (i = 0; i &lt; css-&gt;n; i++)
++				idx[i] = i;
++			for (a = 0; a &lt; css-&gt;n; a++) {
++				for (b = a + 1; b &lt; css-&gt;n; b++) {
++					int sa = css-&gt;rules[idx[a]].specificity;
++					int sb = css-&gt;rules[idx[b]].specificity;
++					/* Lower specificity first; equal keeps
++					 * source order (idx[a] &lt; idx[b]). */
++					if (sb &lt; sa ||
++					    (sb == sa &amp;&amp; idx[b] &lt; idx[a])) {
++						int t = idx[a];
++						idx[a] = idx[b];
++						idx[b] = t;
++					}
++				}
++			}
++			for (i = 0; i &lt; css-&gt;n; i++) {
++				const struct BGTK_CSS_Rule *r =
++					&amp;css-&gt;rules[idx[i]];
++				if (rule_matches(r, tag, id, class_attr))
++					decl_merge(&amp;acc, &amp;r-&gt;decl);
++			}
++			free(idx);
++		}
++	}
++	if (style_attr &amp;&amp; *style_attr) {
++		struct BGTK_CSS_Decl inl;
++		parse_declarations(style_attr, &amp;inl);
++		decl_merge(&amp;acc, &amp;inl);

++/* apps/settings.c
++ *
++ * BGCE + BGTK System Settings application.
++ * GTK theme-chooser style: sidebar list on the left, content panel on the right.
++ *
++ * Sections:
++ *   - Background: type/mode toggles, color input, image path, preview
++ *   - Cursor:     scan system cursor dirs, custom path, select cursor theme
++ *   - Shortcuts:  editable BGCE key bindings
++ *   - Font:       dropdown selector, size, preview
++ *   - Theme:      all BGTK_Theme color/size options
++ *
++ * Uses bgtk_html_parse_inline() to build each page, then wires callbacks.
++ */
++
++#include &lt;dirent.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
++#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
++#include &lt;string.h&gt;
++#include &lt;sys/stat.h&gt;
++#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
++#include &lt;linux/input.h&gt;
++
++#include "bgtk.h"
++#include "html.h"
++#include "config.h"
++#include "internal.h"
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Global state                                                        */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static struct BGTK_Context *ctx;
++static struct config cfg;
++
++static int app_w = 700;
++static int app_h = 480;
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *sidebar_list; /* the list widget inside the scrollable */
++static struct BGTK_Widget *sidebar;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *content_panel;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *root_frame;
++
++static int current_page = 0;
++#define NUM_PAGES 5
++
++static const char *page_names[NUM_PAGES] = {
++	"Background", "Cursor", "Shortcuts", "Font", "Theme"
++};
++
++/* Cached widget pointers for active page */
++static struct BGTK_Widget *bg_color_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *bg_path_input;
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *cursor_path_input;
++
++/* Shortcut inputs (4 rows) */
++static struct BGTK_Widget *shortcut_inputs[4];
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *font_size_input;
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_bg_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_btn_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_btn_text_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_frame_border_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_btn_border_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_input_border_input;
++static struct BGTK_Widget *theme_frame_color_input;
++
++/* Font dropdown state: 0=closed, 1=open */
++static int font_dropdown_open;
++static char **font_list_cache;
++static int font_list_count;
++
++/* Shortcut names/defaults */
++static const char *shortcut_actions[4] = {
++	"Screenshot", "Close window", "Switch window", "Terminal"
++};
++static char shortcut_keys[4][64] = {
++	"SysRq", "Super+Q", "Alt+Tab", "Super+Enter"
++};
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* File scanning helpers                                                */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static int scan_dir(const char *dir, char ***out, int dirs_only)
++{
++	*out = NULL;
++	DIR *d = opendir(dir);
++	if (!d)
++		return 0;
++
++	int cap = 32, n = 0;
++	char **list = malloc(cap * sizeof(char *));
++	struct dirent *ent;
++	while ((ent = readdir(d))) {
++		if (ent-&gt;d_name[0] == '.')
++			continue;
++		if (dirs_only) {
++			char full[1024];
++			snprintf(full, sizeof(full), "%s/%s", dir, ent-&gt;d_name);
++			struct stat st;
++			if (stat(full, &amp;st) || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
++				continue;
++		}
++		if (n &gt;= cap) {
++			cap *= 2;
++			list = realloc(list, cap * sizeof(char *));
++		}
++		list[n++] = strdup(ent-&gt;d_name);
++	}
++	closedir(d);
++	*out = list;
++	return n;
++}
++
++static int scan_fonts(char ***out)
++{
++	static const char *dirs[] = {
++#ifdef __linux__
++		"/usr/share/fonts/truetype",
++		"/usr/share/fonts/TTF",
++		"/usr/share/fonts/opentype",
++		"/usr/local/share/fonts",
++#endif
++#ifdef __APPLE__
++		"/System/Library/Fonts",
++		"/Library/Fonts",
++#endif
++		NULL
++	};
++
++	int cap = 64, n = 0;
++	char **list = malloc(cap * sizeof(char *));
++
++	for (int i = 0; dirs[i]; i++) {
++		char **sub = NULL;
++		int sn = scan_dir(dirs[i], &amp;sub, 0);
++		for (int j = 0; j &lt; sn; j++) {
++			int len = strlen(sub[j]);
++			if (len &gt; 4 &amp;&amp; (!strcasecmp(sub[j] + len - 4, ".ttf") ||
++					!strcasecmp(sub[j] + len - 4, ".otf"))) {
++				if (n &gt;= cap) {
++					cap *= 2;
++					list = realloc(list, cap * sizeof(char *));
++				}
++				char full[1024];
++				snprintf(full, sizeof(full), "%s/%s", dirs[i], sub[j]);
++				list[n++] = strdup(full);
++			}
++			free(sub[j]);
++		}
++		free(sub);
++	}
++	*out = list;
++	return n;
++}
++
++static int scan_cursors(char ***out)
++{
++	static const char *dirs[] = {
++#ifdef __linux__
++		"/usr/share/icons",
++		"/usr/local/share/icons",
++#endif
++		NULL
++	};
++
++	int cap = 32, n = 0;
++	char **list = malloc(cap * sizeof(char *));
++	*out = list;
++
++	for (int i = 0; dirs[i]; i++) {
++		char **sub = NULL;
++		int sn = scan_dir(dirs[i], &amp;sub, 1);
++		for (int j = 0; j &lt; sn; j++) {
++			char cpath[1024];
++			snprintf(cpath, sizeof(cpath), "%s/%s/cursors", dirs[i], sub[j]);
++			struct stat st;
++			if (stat(cpath, &amp;st) == 0 &amp;&amp; S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
++				if (n &gt;= cap) {
++					cap *= 2;
++					list = realloc(list, cap * sizeof(char *));
++					*out = list;
++				}
++				list[n++] = strdup(sub[j]);
++			}
++			free(sub[j]);
++		}
++		free(sub);
++	}
++	return n;
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Widget tree finder helpers                                          */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *find_nth_input(struct BGTK_Widget *w, int *counter, int target)
++{
++	if (!w)
++		return NULL;
++	if (w-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_TEXT_INPUT) {
++		if (*counter == target)
++			return w;
++		(*counter)++;
++	}
++	switch (w-&gt;type) {
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_FRAME:
++		return find_nth_input(w-&gt;data.frame.child, counter, target);
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_LIST:
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; w-&gt;data.list_widget.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *r = find_nth_input(w-&gt;data.list_widget.items[i], counter, target);
++			if (r) return r;
++		}
++		break;
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE:
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; w-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *r = find_nth_input(w-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i], counter, target);
++			if (r) return r;
++		}
++		break;
++	default:
++		break;
++	}
++	return NULL;
++}
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *get_input(struct BGTK_Widget *root, int idx)
++{
++	int c = 0;
++	return find_nth_input(root, &amp;c, idx);
++}
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *find_nth_button(struct BGTK_Widget *w, int *counter, int target)
++{
++	if (!w)
++		return NULL;
++	if (w-&gt;type == BGTK_WIDGET_BUTTON) {
++		if (*counter == target)
++			return w;
++		(*counter)++;
++		return NULL;
++	}
++	switch (w-&gt;type) {
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_FRAME:
++		return find_nth_button(w-&gt;data.frame.child, counter, target);
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_LIST:
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; w-&gt;data.list_widget.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *r = find_nth_button(w-&gt;data.list_widget.items[i], counter, target);
++			if (r) return r;
++		}
++		break;
++	case BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE:
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; w-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count; i++) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *r = find_nth_button(w-&gt;data.scrollable.items[i], counter, target);
++			if (r) return r;
++		}
++		break;
++	default:
++		break;
++	}
++	return NULL;
++}
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *get_button(struct BGTK_Widget *root, int idx)
++{
++	int c = 0;
++	return find_nth_button(root, &amp;c, idx);
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Forward declarations                                                */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void rebuild_content(void);
++static void rebuild_sidebar(void);
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Page switching                                                      */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void page_cb(void *userdata)
++{
++	current_page = (int)(intptr_t)userdata;
++	font_dropdown_open = 0;
++	rebuild_sidebar();
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Apply callbacks                                                     */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static uint32_t parse_color_input(const char *text)
++{
++	if (!text || text[0] != '#' || strlen(text) &lt; 7)
++		return 0xFF000000;
++	unsigned r, g, b;
++	if (sscanf(text + 1, "%02x%02x%02x", &amp;r, &amp;g, &amp;b) != 3)
++		return 0xFF000000;
++	return 0xFF000000 | (r &lt;&lt; 16) | (g &lt;&lt; 8) | b;
++}
++
++static void apply_background(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	if (bg_color_input)
++		cfg.color = parse_color_input(bg_color_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (bg_path_input &amp;&amp; bg_path_input-&gt;data.text_input.text[0])
++		strncpy(cfg.path, bg_path_input-&gt;data.text_input.text, MAX_PATH_LEN - 1);
++	write_config(&amp;cfg);
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void toggle_bg_mode(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	cfg.mode = (cfg.mode == IMAGE_TILED) ? IMAGE_SCALED : IMAGE_TILED;
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void toggle_bg_type(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	cfg.type = (cfg.type == BG_COLOR) ? BG_IMAGE : BG_COLOR;
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void apply_cursor(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	/* Cursor path saved for future BGCE integration */
++	write_config(&amp;cfg);
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void apply_shortcuts(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) {
++		if (shortcut_inputs[i] &amp;&amp; shortcut_inputs[i]-&gt;data.text_input.text[0])
++			strncpy(shortcut_keys[i], shortcut_inputs[i]-&gt;data.text_input.text,
++				sizeof(shortcut_keys[0]) - 1);
++	}
++	/* Shortcuts are stored in memory; would be persisted via BGCE config */
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void apply_font(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	if (font_size_input) {
++		int sz = atoi(font_size_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++		if (sz &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; sz &lt; 200)
++			cfg.font_size = sz;
++	}
++	write_config(&amp;cfg);
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void apply_theme(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	if (theme_bg_input)
++		cfg.theme.background = parse_color_input(theme_bg_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_btn_input)
++		cfg.theme.button = parse_color_input(theme_btn_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_btn_text_input)
++		cfg.theme.button_text = parse_color_input(theme_btn_text_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_frame_border_input)
++		cfg.theme.frame_border_size = atoi(theme_frame_border_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_btn_border_input)
++		cfg.theme.button_border_size = atoi(theme_btn_border_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_input_border_input)
++		cfg.theme.input_border_size = atoi(theme_input_border_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	if (theme_frame_color_input)
++		cfg.theme.frame_border_color = parse_color_input(theme_frame_color_input-&gt;data.text_input.text);
++	write_config(&amp;cfg);
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Font dropdown                                                       */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void font_select_cb(void *userdata)
++{
++	int idx = (int)(intptr_t)userdata;
++	if (idx &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; idx &lt; font_list_count) {
++		strncpy(cfg.font_path, font_list_cache[idx], MAX_PATH_LEN - 1);
++		cfg.font_path[MAX_PATH_LEN - 1] = '\0';
++	}
++	font_dropdown_open = 0;
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++static void toggle_font_dropdown(void *userdata)
++{
++	(void)userdata;
++	font_dropdown_open = !font_dropdown_open;
++	rebuild_content();
++}

++			"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Mode&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;[ %s ]&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;",
++			cfg.path[0] ? cfg.path : "",
++			cfg.mode == IMAGE_SCALED ? "Scaled" : "Tiled");

++
++	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, 4096 - pos,
++		"&lt;/table&gt;"
++		"&lt;p&gt;Preview:&lt;/p&gt;"

++{

++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;%s&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"140\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;%s&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"140\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;%s&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"140\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"

++static char *build_font_html(void)
++{
++	/* Extract display name from current font path */
++	const char *cur_name = cfg.font_path;
++	const char *slash = strrchr(cfg.font_path, '/');
++	if (slash) cur_name = slash + 1;
++	if (!cfg.font_path[0]) cur_name = "(default)";
++
++	int buflen = 8192 + font_list_count * 256;
++	char *buf = malloc(buflen);
++	int pos = 0;
++
++	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
++		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"
++		"&lt;table&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Font&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%d\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;/table&gt;",
++		cur_name, cfg.font_size);
++
++	/* Dropdown list (only when open) */
++	if (font_dropdown_open) {
++		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos, "&lt;ul&gt;");
++		int show = font_list_count &gt; 50 ? 50 : font_list_count;
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; show; i++) {
++			const char *name = strrchr(font_list_cache[i], '/');
++			name = name ? name + 1 : font_list_cache[i];
++			pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
++				"&lt;li&gt;&lt;button&gt;%s&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/li&gt;", name);
++		}
++		pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos, "&lt;/ul&gt;");
++	}
++
++	/* Preview */
++	pos += snprintf(buf + pos, buflen - pos,
++		"&lt;p&gt;Preview:&lt;/p&gt;"
++		"&lt;p&gt;The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog&lt;/p&gt;"
++		"&lt;p&gt;ABCDEFGHIJKLM 0123456789 !@#$%%&lt;/p&gt;"
++		"&lt;div&gt;&lt;button&gt;Apply&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;"
++		"&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;");
++
++	return buf;
++}

++{
++	char bg[16], btn[16], btxt[16], fbc[16];
++	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.background, bg, sizeof(bg));
++	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.button, btn, sizeof(btn));
++	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.button_text, btxt, sizeof(btxt));
++	format_hex_color(cfg.theme.frame_border_color, fbc, sizeof(fbc));
++
++	char *buf = malloc(4096);
++	snprintf(buf, 4096,
++		"&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;"

++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Button&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"100\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Button text&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"100\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Frame border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Button border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Input border size&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%u\" width=\"60\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"
++		"&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Frame border color&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;input type=\"text\" value=\"%s\" width=\"100\" /&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;"

++		bg, btn, btxt,

++		cfg.theme.button_border_size,

++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Background preview: draw a colored/image rect into the content      */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void add_bg_preview(struct BGTK_Widget *page, int panel_w)
++{
++	/* Build a preview widget: a frame filled with the background color */
++	int pw = panel_w - 40;
++	if (pw &lt; 60) pw = 60;
++	int ph = 60;
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *preview;
++	if (cfg.type == BG_IMAGE &amp;&amp; cfg.path[0] &amp;&amp; access(cfg.path, R_OK) == 0) {
++		preview = bgtk_image(ctx, cfg.path, pw, ph, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 0, .margin = 4});
++	} else {
++		/* Color preview: a frame filled with bg color */
++		struct BGTK_Widget *inner = bgtk_text(ctx, " ", (BGTK_Options){0});
++		preview = bgtk_frame(ctx, inner, pw, ph, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 0, .margin = 4});
++		preview-&gt;data.frame.border_w = 1;
++		preview-&gt;data.frame.border_color = BGTK_COLOR_BLACK;
++		/* We'll draw with the configured color by setting the frame bg
++		 * via a custom approach: use the frame, then on draw the bg rect
++		 * will use theme.background. We'll fake it by temporarily overriding.
++		 * Simpler: just draw a colored rect via an image widget with solid pixels. */
++		uint32_t *pix = malloc(pw * ph * sizeof(uint32_t));
++		uint32_t c = cfg.color | 0xFF000000;
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; pw * ph; i++) pix[i] = c;
++		inner-&gt;type = BGTK_WIDGET_IMAGE;
++		inner-&gt;data.image.pixels = pix;
++		inner-&gt;data.image.img_w = pw;
++		inner-&gt;data.image.img_h = ph;
++		inner-&gt;w = pw;
++		inner-&gt;h = ph;
++	}
++
++	/* Find the scrollable and insert preview into its items before the Apply button */
++	/* The page is a frame-&gt;scrollable-&gt;list. We append preview to the list. */
++	if (!page) return;
++	struct BGTK_Widget *scroll = page-&gt;data.frame.child;
++	if (!scroll || scroll-&gt;type != BGTK_WIDGET_SCROLLABLE) return;
++	if (scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count &lt; 1) return;
++	struct BGTK_Widget *list = scroll-&gt;data.scrollable.items[0];
++	if (!list || list-&gt;type != BGTK_WIDGET_LIST) return;
++
++	/* Insert preview before the last item (Apply button) */
++	int n = list-&gt;data.list_widget.widget_count;
++	struct BGTK_Widget **new_items = malloc((n + 1) * sizeof(struct BGTK_Widget *));
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; n - 1; i++)
++		new_items[i] = list-&gt;data.list_widget.items[i];
++	new_items[n - 1] = preview;
++	new_items[n] = list-&gt;data.list_widget.items[n - 1]; /* Apply button */
++	free(list-&gt;data.list_widget.items);
++	list-&gt;data.list_widget.items = new_items;
++	list-&gt;data.list_widget.widget_count = n + 1;
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Rebuild the content panel for current_page                          */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void rebuild_content(void)
++{
++	bg_color_input = bg_path_input = NULL;
++	cursor_path_input = NULL;
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) shortcut_inputs[i] = NULL;
++	font_size_input = NULL;
++	theme_bg_input = theme_btn_input = theme_btn_text_input = NULL;
++	theme_frame_border_input = theme_btn_border_input = NULL;
++	theme_input_border_input = theme_frame_color_input = NULL;
++
++	/* Free old font cache only when leaving font page */
++	if (current_page != 3 &amp;&amp; font_list_cache) {
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; font_list_count; i++)
++			free(font_list_cache[i]);
++		free(font_list_cache);
++		font_list_cache = NULL;
++		font_list_count = 0;
++	}
++
++	/* Pre-scan fonts if on font page and cache is empty */
++	if (current_page == 3 &amp;&amp; !font_list_cache)
++		font_list_count = scan_fonts(&amp;font_list_cache);
++
++	int panel_w = app_w - sidebar-&gt;w - 20;
++	int panel_h = app_h - 16;
++
++	char *html = NULL;
++	switch (current_page) {
++	case 0: html = build_background_html(); break;
++	case 1: html = build_cursor_html(); break;
++	case 2: html = build_shortcuts_html(); break;
++	case 3: html = build_font_html(); break;
++	case 4: html = build_theme_html(); break;
++	}
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *page = bgtk_html_parse_inline(ctx, html, panel_w, panel_h);
++	free(html);
++
++	if (!page)
++		page = bgtk_text(ctx, "Error loading page", (BGTK_Options){.padding = 8});
++
++	/* Wire callbacks */
++	switch (current_page) {
++	case 0: { /* Background: type toggle(0), then type-dependent fields, then apply */
++		struct BGTK_Widget *b;
++		b = get_button(page, 0);
++		if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = toggle_bg_type;
++		if (cfg.type == BG_COLOR) {
++			/* buttons: type(0), apply(1); inputs: color(0) */
++			bg_color_input = get_input(page, 0);
++			b = get_button(page, 1);
++			if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_background;
++		} else {
++			/* buttons: type(0), mode(1), apply(2); inputs: path(0) */
++			bg_path_input = get_input(page, 0);
++			b = get_button(page, 1);
++			if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = toggle_bg_mode;
++			b = get_button(page, 2);
++			if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_background;
++		}
++		add_bg_preview(page, panel_w);
++		break;
++	}
++	case 1: { /* Cursor: input(0)=custom path, buttons=cursor themes..., last=Apply */
++		cursor_path_input = get_input(page, 0);
++		/* Find total button count; last is Apply */
++		int bi = 0;
++		while (get_button(page, bi)) bi++;
++		if (bi &gt; 0) {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *ab = get_button(page, bi - 1);
++			if (ab) ab-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_cursor;
++		}
++		break;
++	}
++	case 2: { /* Shortcuts: inputs 0-3, button 0=Apply */
++		for (int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++)
++			shortcut_inputs[i] = get_input(page, i);
++		struct BGTK_Widget *b = get_button(page, 0);
++		if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_shortcuts;
++		break;
++	}
++	case 3: { /* Font: button(0)=dropdown toggle, then dropdown items, then Apply */
++		struct BGTK_Widget *b = get_button(page, 0);
++		if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = toggle_font_dropdown;
++		font_size_input = get_input(page, 0);
++
++		if (font_dropdown_open) {
++			int show = font_list_count &gt; 50 ? 50 : font_list_count;
++			for (int i = 0; i &lt; show; i++) {
++				struct BGTK_Widget *fb = get_button(page, 1 + i);
++				if (fb) {
++					fb-&gt;data.button.callback = font_select_cb;
++					fb-&gt;data.button.cb_data = (void *)(intptr_t)i;
++				}
++			}
++			struct BGTK_Widget *ab = get_button(page, 1 + show);
++			if (ab) ab-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_font;
++		} else {
++			struct BGTK_Widget *ab = get_button(page, 1);
++			if (ab) ab-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_font;
++		}
++		break;
++	}
++	case 4: { /* Theme */
++		theme_bg_input = get_input(page, 0);
++		theme_btn_input = get_input(page, 1);
++		theme_btn_text_input = get_input(page, 2);
++		theme_frame_border_input = get_input(page, 3);
++		theme_btn_border_input = get_input(page, 4);
++		theme_input_border_input = get_input(page, 5);
++		theme_frame_color_input = get_input(page, 6);
++		struct BGTK_Widget *b = get_button(page, 0);
++		if (b) b-&gt;data.button.callback = apply_theme;
++		break;
++	}
++	}
++
++	content_panel-&gt;data.frame.child = page;
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Sidebar: rebuild with highlight on selected page                    */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++static void rebuild_sidebar(void)
++{
++	int sidebar_w = 140;
++	struct BGTK_Widget **btns = malloc(NUM_PAGES * sizeof(struct BGTK_Widget *));
++
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; NUM_PAGES; i++) {
++		/* Selected page gets inverted colors via header_level trick */
++		char label[64];
++		if (i == current_page)
++			snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "&gt; %s", page_names[i]);
++		else
++			snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "  %s", page_names[i]);
++
++		struct BGTK_Widget *lbl = bgtk_text(ctx, label, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 2});
++
++		/* Use header_level = 10 (fuchsia/bold) for selected item */
++		if (i == current_page)
++			lbl-&gt;data.text.header_level = 10;
++
++		btns[i] = bgtk_button(ctx, lbl, page_cb, (void *)(intptr_t)i,
++			(BGTK_Options){.padding = 6, .margin = 2});
++		btns[i]-&gt;w = sidebar_w - 8;
++		if (i == current_page)
++			btns[i]-&gt;data.button.bg_override = 0xFF505060;
++	}
++
++	sidebar_list = bgtk_list(ctx, btns, NUM_PAGES,
++		(BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_VERTICAL, .margin = 2});
++	free(btns);
++
++	/* Replace the scrollable's content */
++	sidebar-&gt;data.scrollable.items[0] = sidebar_list;
++	sidebar-&gt;data.scrollable.widget_count = 1;
++}
++
++static struct BGTK_Widget *build_sidebar(void)
++{
++	int sidebar_w = 140;
++	struct BGTK_Widget **btns = malloc(NUM_PAGES * sizeof(struct BGTK_Widget *));
++
++	for (int i = 0; i &lt; NUM_PAGES; i++) {
++		char label[64];
++		if (i == current_page)
++			snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "&gt; %s", page_names[i]);
++		else
++			snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "  %s", page_names[i]);
++
++		struct BGTK_Widget *lbl = bgtk_text(ctx, label, (BGTK_Options){.padding = 2});
++		if (i == current_page)
++			lbl-&gt;data.text.header_level = 10;
++
++		btns[i] = bgtk_button(ctx, lbl, page_cb, (void *)(intptr_t)i,
++			(BGTK_Options){.padding = 6, .margin = 2});
++		btns[i]-&gt;w = sidebar_w - 8;
++		if (i == current_page)
++			btns[i]-&gt;data.button.bg_override = 0xFF505060;
++	}
++
++	sidebar_list = bgtk_list(ctx, btns, NUM_PAGES,
++		(BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_VERTICAL, .margin = 2});
++	free(btns);
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *scroll = bgtk_scrollable(ctx, &amp;sidebar_list, 1,
++		(BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 2});
++	scroll-&gt;w = sidebar_w;
++	scroll-&gt;h = app_h - 16;
++
++	return scroll;
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Build the full UI                                                   */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++void settings_build_ui(struct BGTK_Context *c, struct config *config,
++		       int width, int height)
++{
++	ctx = c;
++	cfg = *config;
++	app_w = width;
++	app_h = height;
++	font_dropdown_open = 0;
++
++	sidebar = build_sidebar();
++
++	int panel_w = app_w - sidebar-&gt;w - 20;
++	int panel_h = app_h - 16;
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *placeholder = bgtk_text(ctx, "Select a category",
++		(BGTK_Options){.padding = 8, .margin = 4});
++	content_panel = bgtk_frame(ctx, placeholder, panel_w, panel_h,
++		(BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 2});
++	content_panel-&gt;data.frame.border_w = 1;
++	content_panel-&gt;data.frame.border_color = BGTK_COLOR_GRAY;
++
++	struct BGTK_Widget *cols[2] = { sidebar, content_panel };
++	struct BGTK_Widget *row = bgtk_list(ctx, cols, 2,
++		(BGTK_Options){.orientation = BGTK_LIST_HORIZONTAL, .margin = 2});
++
++	root_frame = bgtk_frame(ctx, row, app_w, app_h,
++		(BGTK_Options){.padding = 2, .margin = 0});
++
++	ctx-&gt;root_widget = root_frame;
++	current_page = 0;
++	rebuild_content();
++}
++
++struct config *settings_get_config(void)
++{
++	return &amp;cfg;
++}
++
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++/* Real BGCE app main (Linux only)                                     */
++/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
++
++#ifndef SETTINGS_TEST_MODE
++
++int main(void)
++{
++	int conn = bgce_connect();
++	if (conn &lt; 0) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "settings: can't connect to BGCE\n");
++		return 1;
++	}

++/* test/test_settings.c
++ *
++ * Headless (mock) test for the settings application.
++ *
++ * Build:  make test_settings
++ * Run:    ./test_settings
++ *
++ * Produces settings_*.png screenshots for visual inspection.
++ * Exercises the sidebar navigation, page content, text input, and apply flow.
++ */
++
++#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;

++			       int width, int height);

++
++int main(void)
++{
++	int width = 700;
++	int height = 480;
++
++	struct BGTK_Context *ctx = bgtk_init_mock(width, height);
++	if (!ctx) {
++		fprintf(stderr, "test_settings: bgtk_init_mock failed\n");
++		return 1;
++	}
++
++	struct config config;
++	init_config_defaults(&amp;config);
++
++	settings_build_ui(ctx, &amp;config, width, height);
++
++	/* 00: Initial view - Background page is shown */
++	bgtk_draw_widgets(ctx);
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_00_background.png");
++
++	/* Sidebar buttons are inside a scrollable; their content-space positions
++	 * are offset by the scrollable's screen position (~8px) plus internal
++	 * padding/margin.  Each button is ~38px tall with ~4px gap.
++	 * Content-space centers: btn0=23, btn1=65, btn2=107, btn3=149, btn4=191.
++	 * Add scrollable screen-y offset (~8) for absolute coords. */
++	#define SIDEBAR_X 70
++	#define SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(n) (31 + (n) * 42)
++
++	/* 01: Click "Cursor" */
++	{
++		struct InputEvent click = {0};
++		click.type = EV_KEY;
++		click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++		click.value = 1;
++		click.x = SIDEBAR_X;
++		click.y = SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(1);
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++		click.value = 0;
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	}
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_01_cursor.png");
++
++	/* 02: Click "Shortcuts" */
++	{
++		struct InputEvent click = {0};
++		click.type = EV_KEY;
++		click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++		click.value = 1;
++		click.x = SIDEBAR_X;
++		click.y = SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(2);
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++		click.value = 0;
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	}
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_02_shortcuts.png");
++
++	/* 03: Click "Font" */
++	{
++		struct InputEvent click = {0};
++		click.type = EV_KEY;
++		click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++		click.value = 1;
++		click.x = SIDEBAR_X;
++		click.y = SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(3);
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++		click.value = 0;
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	}
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_03_font.png");
++
++	/* 04: Click "Theme" */
++	{
++		struct InputEvent click = {0};
++		click.type = EV_KEY;
++		click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++		click.value = 1;
++		click.x = SIDEBAR_X;
++		click.y = SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(4);
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++		click.value = 0;
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	}
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_04_theme.png");
++
++	/* 05: Go back to Background */
++	{
++		struct InputEvent click = {0};
++		click.type = EV_KEY;
++		click.code = BTN_LEFT;
++		click.value = 1;
++		click.x = SIDEBAR_X;
++		click.y = SIDEBAR_BTN_Y(0);
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++		click.value = 0;
++		bgtk_inject_event(ctx, click);
++	}
++	take_screenshot(ctx, "settings_05_back_to_bg.png");
++
++	printf("test_settings complete. PNG files written.\n");
++	bgtk_destroy_mock(ctx);
++	return 0;
++}

+    and bullets render correctly. Apply theme margin/padding on terminal and

+--- a/apps/gemini_browser.c
++++ b/apps/gemini_browser.c

++#include "internal.h"

+@@ -34,61 +35,97 @@ static BGTK_Options line_opts(void)
