+ 
+-static int theme_pad(void)
++/* Theme chrome — same geometry as terminal:
++ * frame draws [margin][border][padding][content]… */
++static void gemini_chrome(int *pad, int *mar, int *bw)
+ {
+-	return (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.padding &gt; 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.padding : 6;
++	int p = (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.padding &gt; 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.padding : 6;
++	int m = (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.margin &gt; 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.margin : 4;
++	int b = ctx ? (int)ctx-&gt;theme.frame_border_size : 1;
++
++	if (b &lt; 1)
++		b = 1;
++	if (pad)
++		*pad = p;
++	if (mar)
++		*mar = m;
++	if (bw)
++		*bw = b;
+ }
+ 
+-static int theme_mar(void)
++/*
++ * Vertical list height overhead beyond sum of children (matches bgtk_list /
++ * draw_list): inter-item 2*M*(n-1) + outer 2*(M+P).
++ * With n=2: 2*M + 2*(M+P) = 4*M + 2*P.
++ */
++static int list_v_overhead(int n, int list_m, int list_p)
+ {
+-	return (ctx &amp;&amp; ctx-&gt;theme.margin &gt; 0) ? ctx-&gt;theme.margin : 4;
++	if (n &lt; 1)
++		return 2 * (list_m + list_p);
++	return 2 * list_m * (n - 1) + 2 * (list_m + list_p);
+ }
+ 
+-/* Outer chrome inset: frame border+pad + list pad/margin. */
+-static int chrome_inset(void)
+-{
+-	int pad = theme_pad();
+-	int mar = theme_mar();
+-	int half = mar &gt; 1 ? mar / 2 : 1;
+-	int bw = ctx ? (int)ctx-&gt;theme.frame_border_size : 1;
+-	if (bw &lt; 1)
+-		bw = 1;
+-	return 2 * (pad + bw + half);
+-}
+-
+-/* Size scroll + URL bar to the current window using theme spacing. */
++/* Size scroll + URL bar so they fit inside the frame content box. */
+ static void gemini_layout_chrome(void)
+ {
+-	int inset, usable_w, ah, scroll_h, half;
++	int pad, mar, bw, box_w, box_h, list_m, list_p, field_pad;
++	int usable_w, ah, scroll_h, over;
+ 
+ 	if (!ctx || !content_scroll || !addr_input)
+ 		return;
+ 
+-	half = theme_mar() &gt; 1 ? theme_mar() / 2 : 1;
+-	inset = chrome_inset();
+-	usable_w = ctx-&gt;width - inset;
+-	if (usable_w &lt; 80)
+-		usable_w = 80;
+-
+-	addr_input-&gt;padding = theme_pad() &gt; 2 ? theme_pad() / 2 : 2;
+-	addr_input-&gt;margin = half;
+-	content_scroll-&gt;padding = half;
+-	content_scroll-&gt;margin = half;
++	gemini_chrome(&amp;pad, &amp;mar, &amp;bw);
++	/* Inner box the frame assigns to its child (main_list). */
++	box_w = ctx-&gt;width - 2 * (mar + bw + pad);
++	box_h = ctx-&gt;height - 2 * (mar + bw + pad);
++	if (box_w &lt; 80)
++		box_w = 80;
++	if (box_h &lt; 80)
++		box_h = 80;
++
++	/*
++	 * Zero list chrome: page + URL bar stack flush inside the frame box.

++uint32_t bgtk_utf8_next_n(const char **s, size_t *nleft)
++{
++	const unsigned char *p;
++	size_t n;
++	uint32_t c;
++
++	if (!s || !*s || !nleft || *nleft == 0)
++		return 0;
++	p = (const unsigned char *)*s;
++	n = *nleft;
++	c = p[0];
++
++	/* ASCII */
++	if (c &lt; 0x80) {
++		*s = (const char *)(p + 1);
++		*nleft = n - 1;
++		return c;
++	}
++
++	/* 2-byte: 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx */
++	if ((c &amp; 0xE0) == 0xC0) {
++		if (n &lt; 2 || (p[1] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80)
++			goto bad;
++		c = ((c &amp; 0x1Fu) &lt;&lt; 6) | (p[1] &amp; 0x3Fu);
++		if (c &lt; 0x80)
++			goto bad; /* overlong */
++		*s = (const char *)(p + 2);
++		*nleft = n - 2;
++		return c;
++	}
++
++	/* 3-byte: 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx */
++	if ((c &amp; 0xF0) == 0xE0) {
++		if (n &lt; 3 || (p[1] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80 || (p[2] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80)
++			goto bad;
++		c = ((c &amp; 0x0Fu) &lt;&lt; 12) | ((p[1] &amp; 0x3Fu) &lt;&lt; 6) | (p[2] &amp; 0x3Fu);
++		if (c &lt; 0x800 || (c &gt;= 0xD800 &amp;&amp; c &lt;= 0xDFFF))
++			goto bad; /* overlong / surrogate */
++		*s = (const char *)(p + 3);
++		*nleft = n - 3;
++		return c;
++	}
++
++	/* 4-byte: 11110xxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx */
++	if ((c &amp; 0xF8) == 0xF0) {
++		if (n &lt; 4 || (p[1] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80 || (p[2] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80 ||
++		    (p[3] &amp; 0xC0) != 0x80)
++			goto bad;
++		c = ((c &amp; 0x07u) &lt;&lt; 18) | ((p[1] &amp; 0x3Fu) &lt;&lt; 12) |

++			goto bad;
++		*s = (const char *)(p + 4);
++		*nleft = n - 4;
++		return c;
++	}
++
++bad:
++	/* Skip one byte; render replacement if caller cares. */
++	*s = (const char *)(p + 1);
++	*nleft = n - 1;
++	return 0xFFFD;
++}

++/*

+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;

+
+    feat: Goldie theme, scroll, and app polish.
+
+    Default Goldie palette with large borders and margin/padding theme
+    options; input_bg for unfocused fields. Terminal scrollback (wheel and
+    PageUp/Down). Gemini browser scroll/shortcuts and full-width URL bar.
+    Launcher file-list rows with highlight selection. Safer scrollable
+    buffer sizing and shm blit clipping.

+<!DOCTYPE html>
+<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+<title>bgtk f63bd87</title>
+<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
+<link rel=icon href=data:,>

+commit f63bd87
+parent <a href=commit-fa733d9.html>fa733d9</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-06T18:37:41-03:00
+
+    build: search $HOME/.local for headers and libraries.
+
+    Add -I$HOME/.local/include and -L$HOME/.local/lib to CFLAGS/LDFLAGS
+    (and headless link) so home-prefix installs of bgce and deps are found.
+
+<a href=tree-f63bd87.html>tree</a>
+
+<b>diff</b>
+
+diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile
+index f9caa42..b464fda 100644
+--- a/Makefile
++++ b/Makefile
+@@ -37,10 +37,15 @@ endif
+ COMPAT_DIR := compat
+ UNAME_S := $(shell uname)
+ 
++# User-local prefix (bgce, freetype, etc. under a home install).
++HOME_LOCAL ?= $(HOME)/.local
++HOME_LOCAL_CFLAGS = -I$(HOME_LOCAL)/include
++HOME_LOCAL_LDFLAGS = -L$(HOME_LOCAL)/lib
++
+ # Base compile flags. Do NOT put -fPIC here: TinyCC errors with
+ # "section type conflict: .symtab 01 &lt;&gt; 02" when linking many PIC
+ # relocatable objects into a normal executable. PIC is only for lib objs.
+-CFLAGS = -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I. $(FREETYPE_CFLAGS) $(LIBXML2_CFLAGS)
++CFLAGS = -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I. $(HOME_LOCAL_CFLAGS) $(FREETYPE_CFLAGS) $(LIBXML2_CFLAGS)
+ 
+ # On non-Linux (no system bgce / linux/input.h), use the in-tree stubs.
+ ifneq ($(UNAME_S),Linux)
+@@ -48,7 +53,7 @@ ifneq ($(UNAME_S),Linux)
+ endif
+ 
+ # Full LDFLAGS are only for real (Linux + bgce server) binaries.
+-LDFLAGS = $(FREETYPE_LIBDIRS) $(FREETYPE_LIBS) $(LIBXML2_LIBS) -lbgce -lm
++LDFLAGS = $(HOME_LOCAL_LDFLAGS) $(FREETYPE_LIBDIRS) $(FREETYPE_LIBS) $(LIBXML2_LIBS) -lbgce -lm
+ # Prefer in-tree libbgtk.so when linking apps (before any system copy).
+ # Runtime search is left to the dynamic linker / LD_LIBRARY_PATH (e.g. home
+ # PREFIX installs); we do not bake rpath into the binaries.
+@@ -90,7 +95,7 @@ GEMINI_BROWSER_OBJ = apps/gemini_browser.o
+ # ---------- Headless / mock testing support ----------
+ # Headless links the bgce stub and does not need a running server.
+ HEADLESS_CFLAGS := $(CFLAGS) -I$(COMPAT_DIR)
+-HEADLESS_LDFLAGS := -L. $(FREETYPE_LIBS) $(FREETYPE_LIBDIRS) $(LIBXML2_LIBS) -lm
++HEADLESS_LDFLAGS := -L. $(HOME_LOCAL_LDFLAGS) $(FREETYPE_LIBS) $(FREETYPE_LIBDIRS) $(LIBXML2_LIBS) -lm
+ HEADLESS_STUB := $(COMPAT_DIR)/bgce_stub.o
+ HEADLESS_OBJ := test/headless.o
+ TEST_TERMINAL_OBJ := test/test_terminal.o
+@@ -143,6 +148,7 @@ help:
+ 	@echo "Variables (override on the command line)"
+ 	@echo "  CC=$(CC)"
+ 	@echo "  CFLAGS=$(CFLAGS)"
++	@echo "  HOME_LOCAL=$(HOME_LOCAL)   # added as -I.../include and -L.../lib"
+ 	@echo "  PREFIX=$(if $(PREFIX),$(PREFIX),(empty → flat /lib /include /bin))"
+ 	@echo "  INSTALL_LIB=$(INSTALL_LIB)"
+ 	@echo "  INSTALL_INCLUDE=$(INSTALL_INCLUDE)"
+@@ -156,6 +162,7 @@ help:
+ 	@echo "  make install"
+ 	@echo "  make install PREFIX=/usr/local"
+ 	@echo "  make install PREFIX=\$$HOME/.local"
++	@echo "  make HOME_LOCAL=\$$HOME/.local"
+ 	@echo "  make install INSTALL_LIB=/opt/bgtk/lib INSTALL_INCLUDE=/opt/bgtk/include"
+ 	@echo "  make snapshot"
+ 
+</pre>

+<!DOCTYPE html>
+<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+<title>bgtk f749530</title>
+<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
+<link rel=icon href=data:,>
+<style>pre{width:52ch;margin:2ch auto;white-space:pre-wrap}a{color:#ff00ff}</style>
+<pre>
+<a href=index.html>bgtk</a> / <b>commit</b>
+
+<a href=log.html>log</a> | <a href=tree.html>tree</a> | <a href=refs.html>refs</a>
+
+commit f749530
+parent <a href=commit-81d5ffc.html>81d5ffc</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-07T16:57:08-03:00
+
+    fix: sticky mod keys, settings UI, fonts, gemini TLS, terminal scroll.
+
+    Clear L/R mod state on focus/Esc so terminal j/k are not sent as Ctrl+J/K
+    (LF/VT) after app switches. Add sans/mono/serif font config and faces.
+    Fix settings Apply hit-testing after preview insert, theme field focus
+    routing, and shortcuts page layout. Retry libtls WANT_POLLIN/POLLOUT in
+    gemini_browser with better logging. Clip terminal glyphs to cells and
+    harden vim-style scroll-region handling.
+
+<a href=tree-f749530.html>tree</a>
+
+<b>diff</b>
+
+diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
+index d06e3a8..b4b840b 100644
+--- a/README.md
++++ b/README.md
+@@ -102,12 +102,16 @@ input_border_size = 2
+ frame_border_size = 4
+ frame_border_color = #333333
+ 
+-# Font settings
++# Font settings (sans = UI; mono = terminal; serif = documents)
+ [font]
+-path = /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf
++sans = /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf
++mono = /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf
++serif = /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf
+ size = 14
+ ```
+ 
++`sans` is the UI face. `mono` is used by the terminal; `serif` is available via `bgtk_font_face(ctx, BGTK_FONT_SERIF)`. If mono/serif are omitted, platform defaults are chosen (falling back to the UI/sans font).
++
+ Colors use `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` format. Lines starting with `#` or `;` are comments.
+ 
+ ### Logging
+diff --git a/apps/gemini_browser.c b/apps/gemini_browser.c
+index 42b2e25..d71fa8c 100644
+--- a/apps/gemini_browser.c
++++ b/apps/gemini_browser.c
+@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@
+ #include &lt;ctype.h&gt;
+ #include &lt;errno.h&gt;

++/*
++ * Modifier bits (left | right tracked separately so releasing one side while
++ * the other is still down does not clear the mod, and a lost release on one
++ * side can still be fixed by releasing the other / focus clear).
++ * bit0 = left, bit1 = right.

++#define MOD_L 1
++#define MOD_R 2
++
+ void bgtk_update_modifiers(struct BGTK_Context *ctx, struct InputEvent ev)
+ {
+-	int held;
++	int on;
++	int *slot = NULL;
++	int bit = 0;
+ 
+ 	if (!ctx || ev.type != EV_KEY)
+ 		return;
+-	held = (ev.value != 0);
+-	if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTSHIFT || ev.code == KEY_RIGHTSHIFT)
+-		ctx-&gt;shift_held = held;
+-	else if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTCTRL || ev.code == KEY_RIGHTCTRL)
+-		ctx-&gt;ctrl_held = held;
+-	else if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTALT || ev.code == KEY_RIGHTALT)
+-		ctx-&gt;alt_held = held;
++	/* value: 0=release, 1=press, 2=repeat — only 0 clears. */
++	on = (ev.value != 0);
++
++	if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTSHIFT) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;shift_held;
++		bit = MOD_L;
++	} else if (ev.code == KEY_RIGHTSHIFT) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;shift_held;
++		bit = MOD_R;
++	} else if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTCTRL) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;ctrl_held;
++		bit = MOD_L;
++	} else if (ev.code == KEY_RIGHTCTRL) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;ctrl_held;
++		bit = MOD_R;
++	} else if (ev.code == KEY_LEFTALT) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;alt_held;
++		bit = MOD_L;
++	} else if (ev.code == KEY_RIGHTALT) {
++		slot = &amp;ctx-&gt;alt_held;
++		bit = MOD_R;
++	} else {
++		return;
++	}
++
++	if (on)
++		*slot |= bit;
++	else
++		*slot &amp;= ~bit;
+ }

+--- a/widgets.c

+ // Frame event handler
+ static int frame_handle_event(struct BGTK_Widget *widget, struct InputEvent ev)
+ {
++	struct BGTK_Widget *child = widget-&gt;data.frame.child;
++
+ 	// Keyboard events don't have meaningful pointer coordinates.
+ 	// Forward them to the child without bounds checking.
+ 	if (ev.type == EV_KEY) {
+-		if (widget-&gt;data.frame.child) {

+-								      data.

++		if (child)

+ 	      ev.y &gt;= widget-&gt;y &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; (widget-&gt;y + widget-&gt;h))) {
+ 		return 0;	// Event not in this widget
+ 	}
+-	// Pass event to child widget if it exists

+-		int cy0 = widget-&gt;data.frame.child-&gt;y;

++	// Pass event to child widget if it exists and the point is in the child

++		int cy0 = child-&gt;y;

++		int cy1 = cy0 + child-&gt;h;
+ 
+ 		if (ev.x &gt;= cx0 &amp;&amp; ev.x &lt; cx1 &amp;&amp; ev.y &gt;= cy0 &amp;&amp; ev.y &lt; cy1) {
+-			return widget-&gt;data.frame.child-&gt;handle_event(widget-&gt;
+-								      data.
+-								      frame.
+-								      child,
+-								      ev);
++			if (child-&gt;handle_event(child, ev))
++				return 1;
++		}
++		/* Click on cell padding (common in HTML tables): focus a
++		 * text-input child so the user can type without a pixel-perfect
++		 * hit on the field. */

+ 	}

+<!DOCTYPE html>
+<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+<title>bgtk fa733d9</title>
+<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
+<link rel=icon href=data:,>
+<style>pre{width:52ch;margin:2ch auto;white-space:pre-wrap}a{color:#ff00ff}</style>

+
+commit fa733d9
+parent <a href=commit-0215c17.html>0215c17</a> 
+author Brian Mayer &lt;bleemayer@gmail.com&gt;
+date   2026-07-06T16:29:52-03:00
+
+    Revert rpath embedding; rely on LD_LIBRARY_PATH for home installs.
+
+    Apps stay linked with -L. -lbgtk only so the dynamic linker uses the
+    environment (and system paths), matching PREFIX=$HOME/.local workflows.
+
+<a href=tree-fa733d9.html>tree</a>
+
+<b>diff</b>
+
+diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile
+index 9543b56..f9caa42 100644
+--- a/Makefile
++++ b/Makefile
+@@ -50,13 +50,9 @@ endif
+ # Full LDFLAGS are only for real (Linux + bgce server) binaries.
+ LDFLAGS = $(FREETYPE_LIBDIRS) $(FREETYPE_LIBS) $(LIBXML2_LIBS) -lbgce -lm
+ # Prefer in-tree libbgtk.so when linking apps (before any system copy).
+-# RPATH so the runtime linker finds libbgtk.so without LD_LIBRARY_PATH:
+-#   - $(INSTALL_LIB) for installed layout (/lib or PREFIX/lib)
+-#   - $$ORIGIN so a co-located lib next to the binary also works
+-#   - . for running from the build tree (./launcher after make)
+-# Yes, LD_LIBRARY_PATH is still honored by the dynamic linker if set.
+-RPATH_FLAGS = -Wl,-rpath,$(INSTALL_LIB) -Wl,-rpath,'$$ORIGIN' -Wl,-rpath,.
+-APP_LDFLAGS = -L. -lbgtk $(RPATH_FLAGS) $(LDFLAGS)
++# Runtime search is left to the dynamic linker / LD_LIBRARY_PATH (e.g. home
++# PREFIX installs); we do not bake rpath into the binaries.
++APP_LDFLAGS = -L. -lbgtk $(LDFLAGS)
+ 
+ # openpty() lives in libutil on Linux; on macOS it is in libSystem.
+ PTY_LIBS :=
+@@ -152,12 +148,6 @@ help:
+ 	@echo "  INSTALL_INCLUDE=$(INSTALL_INCLUDE)"
+ 	@echo "  INSTALL_BIN=$(INSTALL_BIN)"
+ 	@echo ""
+-	@echo "Runtime library search (libbgtk.so)"
+-	@echo "  Apps link with -lbgtk and rpath: $(INSTALL_LIB), \$$ORIGIN, and ."
+-	@echo "  The dynamic linker also honors LD_LIBRARY_PATH if set, e.g.:"
+-	@echo "    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ./launcher"
+-	@echo "  After 'make install' (+ ldconfig on Linux), /lib is enough."
+-	@echo ""
+ 	@echo "Examples"
+ 	@echo "  make"
+ 	@echo "  make CC=cc"
+@@ -165,9 +155,9 @@ help:
+ 	@echo "  make headless &amp;&amp; ./headless"
+ 	@echo "  make install"
+ 	@echo "  make install PREFIX=/usr/local"
++	@echo "  make install PREFIX=\$$HOME/.local"
+ 	@echo "  make install INSTALL_LIB=/opt/bgtk/lib INSTALL_INCLUDE=/opt/bgtk/include"
+ 	@echo "  make snapshot"
+-	@echo "  LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ./launcher"
+ 
+ # Shared library objects need -fPIC; app objects must not (TinyCC).
+ $(LIB_OBJS): CFLAGS += -fPIC
+</pre>
